title: Machine Learning Intern
description:
Business Unit

What the Role Entails

Tencent is a world-leading internet and technology company that develops innovative products and services to improve the quality of life of people around the world. Founded in 1998 with its headquarters in Shenzhen China, our guiding principle is to use technology for good.

We are not only a major video game publisher in the world, we also produce other high-quality digital content, enriching interactive entertainment experiences for people around the globe. We offer a range of services such as cloud computing, advertising, FinTech, and other enterprise services to support our clients' digital transformation and business growth.

Interactive Entertainment Group (IEG) is responsible for the R&D, operation, and development of the company's interactive entertainment business including games and eSports. Through online gaming, live broadcasts, and offline eSports, IEG assists the company in leading the global interactive entertainment market to create better interactive entertainment content experiences for users.

Responsibilities:

• Analyze large-scale datasets to solve complex business and technical challenges in gaming through analytics, forecasting, machine learning, recommender systems, generative AI, experimentation, causal inference, and econometrics.

• Collaborate with product and engineering teams to develop data-driven strategies and implement solutions that enhance business value.

• Deliver actionable business insights to internal and external stakeholders.

• Develop and maintain robust data scraping and collection pipelines (web crawling, API ingestion, data wrangling) to gather competitive intelligence, market signals, and player/community data at scale.

• Stay updated with the latest advancements in data science, machine learning, and generative AI, utilizing these technologies to innovate in gaming applications.

• Engage in technical knowledge sharing, documentation, and cross-team collaboration.

Who We Look For

• Pursuing a M.S., or Ph.D. degree in a quantitative discipline such as Statistics, Math, Economics, Computer Science, Machine Learning, etc.

•  Experience in statistical analysis (probabilities, hypothesis testing, multivariate analysis, time series analysis, predictive modeling, A/B experiments, etc.).

• Experience with building complex data products and machine learning systems on large datasets preferred. Hands on experience on fraud detection is a plus

• Proficient in Python and SQL.Solid understanding of modern AI/LLM and hands-on experience applying them to real-world problems is a plus

• Excellent communication, collaboration, execution capabilities, and keen business acumen.

• Passionate about games and the gaming industry. Gaming experiences in FPS/TPS is a plus.

US-California-Palo Alto

title: Cyber Security Engineer Intern
description:
About the Hiring Team

What the Role Entails
Business Unit
Tencent Overseas IT is committed to accelerating Tencent's international business growth and enabling its success through the deployment of cutting-edge technology platforms in IT services, AI infrastructure, security, cloud, and DevOps. As leaders in IT technology, we are responsible for defining and executing on Tencent's Overseas IT strategy, architecture, and roadmap. Our primary focus is to deliver exceptional value to satisfy the diverse needs of our internal and external customers, while striving to build a world-class global IT team. We are seeking a motivated and enthusiastic Software Engineer to join our Security Team. The successful candidate will assist in maintaining and improving our security infrastructure, protecting our organization from cyber threats, and ensuring compliance with industry standards and regulations.
What the Role Entails

You will have the opportunity to work on projects across OIT's engineering portfolio, depending on team needs and your interests, including:

SaaS Platforms & Identity Management: Support the operations and security of SaaS platforms and services used across Tencent. Contribute to identity and access management (IAM) systems and integrations. Work on user authentication, and authorization solutions.

DevOps, SRE & Observability: Contribute to deployment pipelines and system reliability. Work with monitoring, logging, and alerting systems. Develop automation and tooling for operational tasks. Support incident response and system troubleshooting.

Security Operations & Data Pipelines: Contribute to security operations and threat monitoring. Develop data ingestion, processing, or analytics systems. Work with data storage, querying, and real-time data flows at scale.

Who We Look For

Who We Look For

1. Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field (recent graduates preferred).

2. Core Engineering Skills:

•
Proficient with at least one programming language (Python, Go, Java, C++, etc.)

•
Comfortable with Linux/Unix command line and shell scripting

•
Understanding of fundamental data structures, algorithms, and system design concepts

•
Ability to read code, debug issues, and understand software architecture

3. Infrastructure & Systems Fundamentals

•
Basic understanding of distributed systems, microservices, and system architecture

•
Familiarity with containerization concepts (Docker) or virtualization

•
Understanding of networking basics (TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS)

•
Exposure to monitoring, logging, or operational concepts

4. Problem-Solving & Learning:

•
Ability to decompose problems, research solutions, and debug systematically

•
Comfortable with ambiguity; willing to learn new tools and technologies quickly

•
Strong written and verbal communication skills

5. Growth & Collaboration:

•
Takes initiative on assigned projects; proactive about learning from experienced engineers

•
Works well in teams; receptive to feedback and code reviews

•
Curious about how systems work; asks thoughtful questions

Preferred Qualifications

•
Systems & Networking: Experience with network protocols, load balancing, service mesh, or distributed tracing.

•
Cloud Services: Proficiency with AWS, GCP, or Azure services; experience deploying and managing applications on cloud platforms.

•
Containerization & Orchestration: Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, or similar container technologies.

•
Data Systems: Experience with databases, data pipelines, message queues, or stream processing.

•
Security & Compliance: Exposure to infrastructure security, identity and access management, or security tooling.

•
Performance & Optimization: Experience profiling, debugging, or optimizing system performance and resource efficiency.

•
Open Source & Community: Contributions to open-source projects or participation in tech communities.

title: Associate, Global AI Policy
description:
About the Hiring Team

What the Role Entails
A. About Tencent

Tencent is a leading global technology and entertainment company focused on connecting people and developing innovative products and services. Founded in 1998 and publicly traded on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange since 2004, Tencent’s communication and social services, entertainment (video games, music, sports, and film/TV), fintech, cloud, and enterprise solutions are used by hundreds of millions of people around the world.

Tencent has been recognized as one of the “World’s Best Employers” (Forbes), including as one of the “Best Workplaces for New Graduates” (2026); one of the “World’s Most Admired Companies” (Fortune); and one of the “World’s Best Companies” (Time). In addition to its headquarters in Shenzhen, Tencent maintains offices across Asia, Europe, North America, and Latin America, including Hong Kong, Singapore, Tokyo, Seoul, Amsterdam, London, Paris, Palo Alto, Los Angeles, New York, and Washington, D.C. To learn more about the company, visit www.Tencent.com (About Us).

B. About the Role

Tencent is seeking a highly motivated Associate, Global AI Policy to join its Global Public Affairs team in Palo Alto. This early-career position offers a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of artificial intelligence, public policy, technology, and international affairs.

The Associate will support Tencent's global AI policy efforts by researching emerging policy developments, monitoring legislative and regulatory activity, analyzing technology trends, and helping develop insights for Tencent businesses. The role will work closely with colleagues across public affairs, legal, compliance, and AI and Cloud product teams, while also engaging with external stakeholders including policymakers, think tanks, industry associations, academic institutions, and civil society organizations.

While the position will be based in Palo Alto, the successful candidate will contribute to Tencent's assessment and understanding of broader AI trends globally, including the US but also Europe, Asia-Pacific, etc.
Policy Research & Analysis

• Monitor and analyze developments related to artificial intelligence, including machine learning, generative AI, agentic AI, semiconductors, and other emerging technologies.

• Track and assess industry initiatives and policy developments in the United States and other key international markets.

• Prepare concise policy briefings, research memoranda, presentations, and executive summaries for internal stakeholders.

• Support analysis of AI policy trends and their potential implications for Tencent's business and technology strategy.

• Identify emerging risks, opportunities, and policy developments relevant to Tencent's AI and cloud businesses.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Partner with internal teams across public affairs, legal, compliance, product, engineering, and research functions.

• Assist with the development of policy positions, consultation responses, and external-facing materials.

• Support preparation for meetings, conferences, speaking engagements, and policy discussions.

Stakeholder Engagement

• Assist in managing relationships with think tanks, academic institutions, trade associations, and policy organizations.

• Support Tencent's participation in AI policy forums, conferences, workshops, and industry events.

• Help coordinate internal and external meetings and maintain stakeholder engagement databases and tracking tools.

Who We Look For

We are looking for an intellectually curious individual who enjoys learning about complex issues and translating them into clear insights for business and policy teams. The ideal candidate is a strong writer, a disciplined researcher, and someone who is genuinely excited by the policy questions surrounding artificial intelligence and emerging technologies. Successful candidates may come from leading universities, graduate programs, consulting firms, think tanks, policy research organizations, or technology companies. Most importantly, they should possess strong analytical instincts, sound judgment, and a desire to help shape the future of AI policy in a rapidly changing global environment.

Specific qualifications include:

• Bachelor's degree required; Master's degree preferred. Relevant fields include Public Policy, International Affairs, Political Science, Economics, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Engineering, Law, or related disciplines.

• Strong interest in artificial intelligence, technology policy, innovation, and emerging technologies.

• Exceptional research, writing, and analytical skills are required.

• Ability to synthesize complex information into clear and actionable insights.

• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced and multi-cultural environment.

• Familiarity with AI governance, technology regulation, or digital/cloud policy preferred.

• Mandarin with international teams preferred but not required

• Experience conducting quantitative or qualitative policy research.

Location State(s)

US-California-Palo Alto

The expected base pay range for this position in the location(s) listed above is $82,700.00 to $200,600.00 per year. Actual pay may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.
Employees hired for this position may be eligible for a sign on payment, relocation package, and restricted stock units, which will be evaluated on a case-by-case basis.
Subject to the terms and conditions of the plans in effect, hired applicants are also eligible for medical, dental, vision, life and disability benefits, and participation in the Company’s 401(k) plan. The Employee is also eligible for up to 15 to 25 days of vacation per year (depending on the employee’s tenure), up to 13 days of holidays throughout the calendar year, and up to 10 days of paid sick leave per year.
Your benefits may be adjusted to reflect your location, employment status, duration of employment with the company, and position level. Benefits may also be pro-rated for those who start working during the calendar year.

title: Product Manager – AI Creator Platform
description:
Business Unit

What the Role Entails

Key Responsibilities

Product Strategy & Roadmap

• Own the product strategy and roadmap for WorkSolo's overseas markets, aligning HQ vision with local creator needs

• Define product North Star metrics and success criteria (activation, retention, creation depth, publish-through rate, monetization)

• Translate market insights, competitive intelligence, and creator behavior trends into prioritized product bets

AI-Native Feature Design

• Lead end-to-end product design for AI creation workflows — covering ideation, generation, editing, collaboration, and publishing

• Define and ship features around multimodal generation (text-to-image, text-to-video, voice, 3D), agentic workflows, asset management, and creator monetization

• Partner with AI/ML, design, and engineering teams to ship high-quality experiences at startup speed

User Research & Market Insight

• Build a continuous discovery system: creator interviews, usability studies, community listening, and quantitative analysis

• Synthesize insights from Discord, Reddit, X/Twitter, YouTube, and TikTok creator ecosystems into product requirements

• Develop deep personas for AI creators (independents, studios, professional creatives) and map their end-to-end workflows

Localization & Market Fit

• Drive product localization strategy across language, payment, content policy, and creator economics for key markets (North America, EU, JP/KR, SEA, LATAM)

• Define market-specific feature variants, onboarding flows, and pricing/packaging in collaboration with operations and growth

• Champion the international user's voice within HQ; influence the global product roadmap with regional priorities

Data & Experimentation

• Build a rigorous experimentation culture: hypothesis → A/B test → learning loops

• Define instrumentation requirements and partner with data teams on dashboards, funnels, and cohort analysis

• Use analytics tools (Amplitude, Mixpanel, Looker, etc.) to monitor product health and identify growth levers

AIGC Ecosystem & Partnerships

description:
Business Unit
Cloud & Smart Industries Group (CSIG) is responsible for promoting the company's cloud and industry Internet strategy. CSIG explores the interactions between users and industries to create innovative solutions for smart industries via technological advancements such as cloud, AI, and network security. While driving the digitalization of retail, medical, education, transportation and other industries, CSIG helps companies serve users in smarter ways, building a new ecosystem of intelligent industries that connect users and businesses.

What the Role Entails

1.Architecture Research: Conduct in-depth research into the underlying hardware logic of various AI accelerators; evaluate the power-efficiency ratio and suitability of different heterogeneous architectures in the context of Large Language Model (LLM) inference and training.

2.Operator & Performance Optimization: Design and optimize high-performance operator libraries for large-scale cloud computing environments; resolve long-tail latency issues in hardware scheduling, memory management, and distributed communication.

3.Interconnect Architecture Definition: Define the interconnect architecture ; drive the virtualization, standardized access, and efficient pooling of heterogeneous computing resources in the cloud.

4.Technology Trend Analysis: Monitor global trends in semiconductors and accelerators; perform feasibility studies and experimental validation for the implementation of emerging technologies within cloud infrastructure.

Who We Look For

title: Marketing Manager
description:
团队介绍
Level Infinite 是腾讯旗下国际游戏业务品牌，致力为全球玩家带来充满乐趣、原汁原味的游戏体验，让玩家随时随地进入游戏世界；并通过打造包容、互通、便捷的玩家社区，促进分享交流。

Level Infinite为合作工作室提供一系列支持及服务，助力其释放产品潜能。

Level Infinite发行产品包括《PUBG MOBILE》、《Goddess of Victory: NIKKE 》《Honor of King》等热门游戏，并与合作工作室联手推出了来自Fatshark的《战锤40K：暗潮》、Funcom的《沙丘：觉醒》、Inflexion Studios的《夜莺》在内多款产品。

想进一步了解Level Infinite，请访问www.levelinfinite.com，并在Twitter、Facebook、Instagram和Youtube上关注我们的官方账号。

岗位职责

1. IP品牌策略与传播 —— 负责成熟游戏产品的IP品牌建设与用户口碑营销，基于产品核心卖点与用户画像，制定市场发行策略，主导创意构思并推动高质量落地执行；

2. 内容生态与流量增长 —— 深刻理解主流内容平台的流量分发逻辑，保持敏锐的热点感知与内容创新能力，策划并产出具备自传播力的PGC及UGC内容，持续扩大IP传播声量与用户影响力；

3. 跨界联动与资源整合 —— 策划并引入泛娱乐、异业合作、文旅联动等外部资源，主导跨界传播内容及话题事件的全流程落地，拓展IP破圈能力；

4. 用户洞察与策略迭代 —— 统筹用户沟通与调研体系，协同用研团队持续深化用户画像，以洞察反哺市场策略，驱动发行打法与用户沟通策略的动态优化；

5. 整合营销与效果度量 —— 拆解整合营销全链路，搭建可量化的效果追踪体系与评估标准，结合内容数据复盘与分析，持续迭代发行策略与执行手段。

岗位要求

1. 本科及以上学历，市场营销、广告传播、心理学或游戏相关专业优先；
2. 5年以上游戏行业市场营销经验，至少主导过1款产品的全案传播及IP联动项目，有成熟案例可展示；
3. 市场嗅觉敏锐，深谙抖音、B站、小红书等平台的内容生态与流量机制，有爆款创意内容或事件营销的成功操盘经验者优先；
4. 熟悉主流AI大模型及效率工具，能将其有效嵌入发行工作流并持续优化提效，对AI赋能营销有实际应用经验；
5. 数据驱动、结果导向，具备复杂问题的拆解、定位与解决能力，善于从执行数据中发现趋势或风险，推动策略调整与落地；
6. 出色的跨部门沟通与项目管理能力，既能深入理解用户视角与诉求，也能高效推进组织内外多方协作，确保项目闭环。

腾讯致力于提供平等就业机会

在腾讯，我们始终秉承平等就业机会的原则，致力于为每一位员工打造公平、包容的工作环境。我们坚信，多元的声音能够激发出无限的创新活力，推动我们为用户和社会提供更优质的服务。我们用心营造一个充满支持与激励的氛围，帮助每一位员工找到属于自己的舞台，以实现个人及共同的发展目标。

description:

仕事内容

ゲーム内のキャラクター、環境、オブジェクトなどの3Dモデルを制作します。ゲームのテーマやストーリーに沿ったデザインを行います。

2.テクスチャリングとシェーディング

モデルにリアルな質感を与えるためのテクスチャリングとシェーディング作業を行います。

3.リギングとアニメーションの準備

キャラクターやオブジェクトが自然に動くためのリギングを行い、アニメーターが使用するための準備をします。

ゲーム全体のアートスタイルに一貫性を持たせるため、他のアーティストと連携しながら作業を進めます。

5.ビジュアルコンセプトの実現

ゲームのビジュアルコンセプトに基づいて、アイデアを具体化し、魅力的なビジュアルを創り出します。

6.ドキュメント作成

作業手順や技術的なドキュメントを整備し、チーム内での情報共有を促進します。

Job Description

1. 3D Modeling

- Create 3D models of characters, environments, and objects for in-game use, ensuring designs align with the game's theme and story.

2. Texturing and Shading

- Perform texturing and shading tasks to give models realistic surface qualities.

3. Rigging and Animation Preparation

- Set up rigging for characters and objects to ensure natural movement and prepare them for use by animators.

4. Maintaining Art Style

- Work collaboratively with other artists to maintain consistency in the overall art style of the game.

5. Visual Concept Realization

- Bring ideas to life based on the game’s visual concept, creating appealing visuals.

6. Documentation

- Prepare work procedures and technical documents to facilitate information sharing within the team.

1.3Dアート制作の経験（AAAまたはAAプロジェクトが望ましい）

2.3Dモデリングツールの使用スキル（Maya、3ds Max、Blenderなど）

3.テクスチャリングおよびシェーディングに関する知識

4.3Aアクションゲームの開発経験（優遇）

5.優れた描写能力と創造力

6.チームでの協力とコミュニケーション能力

Qualifications

- Experience in 3D art production (preferably in AAA or AA projects)

- Proficiency in using 3D modeling tools (such as Maya, 3ds Max, Blender)

- Knowledge of texturing and shading

- Experience in developing AAA action games(preferred)

- Strong drawing skills and creativity

title: Senior Marketing Manager JD (AAA Racing Game Title)
description:
About the Hiring Team
Level Infinite is Tencent’s global gaming brand. It is a global game publisher offering a comprehensive network of services for games, development teams, and studios around the world.

We are dedicated to delivering engaging and original gaming experiences to a worldwide audience, whenever and wherever they choose to play while building a community that fosters inclusivity, connection, and accessibility. Level Infinite also provides a wide range of services and resources to our network of developers and partner studios around the world to help them unlock the true potential of their games.

What the Role Entails

1. Develop the overall brand marketing strategy, positioning, and core messaging framework for the AAA driving game product before and after its global launch, ensuring consistent communication of the brand concept across regions worldwide.
2. Lead brand creative work throughout the product's full lifecycle from testing through post-launch, including creative planning and execution for key marketing milestones such as the global first reveal, test-phase promotions, integrated online and offline marketing campaigns, and launch events.
3. Develop a deep understanding of the core console/PC player ecosystem and global driving culture communities, formulate community growth and engagement strategies, maintain relationships with core players, and stimulate the content ecosystem.
4. Continuously track market trends in the driving and open-world racing categories, competitor developments, and player feedback, providing data-driven insights for marketing decisions and product optimization.
5. Collaborate with multiple cross-functional teams, including operations, UA, regional marketing teams, and platform partnership teams, integrate in-game resources with global and regional resources, and drive the quality execution of final solutions.
6. Deeply participate in the development and execution coordination of market strategies in key regions, ensuring localized messaging and precise localization are implemented within a globally consistent brand framework.

Who We Look For

1. Required Experience:
- 5+ years of experience in game industry marketing or brand roles.
- Proven experience successfully leading AAA console/PC game brand projects; candidates with experience in open-world, driving/racing, or RPG projects are preferred.
- Global market GTM marketing experience, with familiarity with player ecosystems in at least 2 regional markets (North America/Europe/Asia).
2. Core Competencies
- Deep understanding of driving culture and player psychology: Understands the appeal of automotive culture and the driving experience, and can accurately grasp the community language, emotional needs, and behavioral patterns of driving game players.
- Fluent English: Near-native written and spoken English proficiency, with the ability to independently write English brand copy and creative briefs, understand the vision of overseas studios, and communicate seamlessly with international teams and overseas partners.
- Passion for games: Hardcore gamer with a deep understanding of the console/PC gaming ecosystem and familiarity with the full lifecycle of AAA game launch marketing. Hands-on experience with driving/racing games is preferred.
- Strategy and creativity: Possesses both systematic brand strategy thinking and sharp creative judgment, with the ability to lead end-to-end marketing output.
3. Preferred Qualifications
- Experience in co-marketing with console platform partners is preferred.
- Ability to collaborate with regional marketing teams and support coordination with overseas regional markets.
- Automotive brand cross-over partnership experience or automotive media/KOL resources are preferred; experience in creator community operations or UGC content ecosystems is also preferred.
4. Personal Attributes
- Strong execution and drive: Self-motivated, skilled at cross-department coordination, and capable of driving complex projects to completion across multicultural, multi-time-zone teams.
- Strategic thinker: Able to establish clear frameworks in ambiguous and rapidly changing environments.
- Passion for automotive culture: Genuinely cares about cars, driving, and the relationship between people and cars.

title: Tencent Cloud – AI & LLM Solution Architect
description:
Business Unit
Cloud & Smart Industries Group (CSIG) is responsible for promoting the company's cloud and industry Internet strategy. CSIG explores the interactions between users and industries to create innovative solutions for smart industries via technological advancements such as cloud, AI, and network security. While driving the digitalization of retail, medical, education, transportation and other industries, CSIG helps companies serve users in smarter ways, building a new ecosystem of intelligent industries that connect users and businesses.

What the Role Entails

Position Overview

Tencent Cloud is seeking an AI & LLM Solution Architect to accelerate the adoption of Tencent Cloud's enterprise AI platform across Europe. This customer-facing technical role combines solution architecture, customer engineering, and hands-on AI implementation to help enterprises design, build, deploy, and scale production-ready AI applications. Leveraging Tencent Cloud TokenHub—a unified AI platform providing access to leading Large Language Models (LLMs), AI Agents, and the Model Context Protocol (MCP) ecosystem—you will work closely with enterprise customers, Product, Engineering, Research, and Commercial teams to bridge business challenges with innovative AI solutions. Beyond solution delivery, you will serve as the technical bridge between customers and Tencent Cloud's AI product organization, translating real-world customer requirements into product enhancements while accelerating enterprise AI adoption. TokenHub provides enterprises and developers with a unified gateway to leading foundation models through a single API, together with enterprise-grade model management, inference, deployment, monitoring, and AI application capabilities. Product Link: https://www.tencentcloud.com/products/tokenhub?from_qcintl=topnav

Responsibilities

•
Partner with enterprise customers to understand business challenges, identify AI transformation opportunities, and design end-to-end AI and LLM solutions leveraging Tencent Cloud TokenHub, leading foundation models, AI Agents, MCP ecosystem, and enterprise AI capabilities.

•
Lead technical discovery workshops, architecture design sessions, Proof-of-Concepts (POCs), technical validation, and production deployment planning to accelerate enterprise AI adoption.

•
Work directly with customer engineering teams throughout implementation and production rollout, troubleshooting complex technical issues and optimizing AI application performance within enterprise production environments.

•
Design scalable enterprise AI architectures utilizing Large Language Models (LLMs), Prompt Engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI Agents, Model Context Protocol (MCP), model fine-tuning, inference optimization, vector databases, API integration, AI workflow orchestration, and cloud-native AI services.

•
Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, and Research teams to translate customer requirements into platform enhancements, improve developer experience, and continuously evolve Tencent Cloud's AI platform through customer-driven feedback.

•
Develop reusable reference architectures, implementation frameworks, sample applications, technical playbooks, and best practices that accelerate enterprise AI adoption across European customers and partners.

•
Support strategic enterprise opportunities by leading technical proposals, architecture reviews, executive presentations, tender responses, and technical due diligence throughout the customer lifecycle.

Who We Look For

•
Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

•
Minimum 2 years of experience in Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), machine learning, AI platforms, cloud computing, software engineering, MLOps, solution architecture, or customer-facing technical consulting.

•
Hands-on experience with modern AI technologies including LLMs, Prompt Engineering, RAG, AI Agents, MCP, model fine-tuning, inference optimization, vector databases, AI orchestration frameworks, API integration, and cloud-native AI architectures.

•
Experience developing or deploying enterprise AI applications on public cloud platforms, with practical knowledge of multi-model AI orchestration, model deployment, inference services, observability, and production operations.

•
Strong customer-facing communication, presentation, analytical, and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex business requirements into scalable AI solutions.

•
Excellent written and spoken English is required. Proficiency in Chinese Mandarin is required to collaborate with China headquarters on product discussions, technical design, and cross-functional initiatives.

•
Self-driven with strong learning agility, curiosity for emerging AI technologies, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced customer-facing environment.

Equal Employment Opportunity at Tencent

As an equal opportunity employer, we firmly believe that diverse voices fuel our innovation and allow us to better serve our users and the community. We foster an environment where every employee of Tencent feels supported and inspired to achieve individual and common goals.

This role will ensure that player insights are integrated into game design and development processes, driving player satisfaction and business growth. The Senior UX Researcher will collaborate closely with partnered studios, Shenzhen-based partner teams, and IEG and IEGG support functions, such as iMur, Checkpoint and other support departments and vendors.

UX Research Leadership:

• Design and execute comprehensive UX research studies to evaluate player behavior, preferences, and pain points across multiple game titles.

• Collaborate with invested studios to identify research needs and provide strategic guidance on UX improvements.

Cross-Functional Collaboration:

• Partner with assigned teams in Shenzhen to align research objectives with business goals and ensure seamless communication between Tencent HQ and invested studios.

• Collaborate with game designers, product managers, and developers to translate research findings into actionable design recommendations.

Global Perspective:

• Conduct research that accounts for cultural differences and regional player preferences, ensuring games resonate with diverse audiences.

• Foster a culture of collaboration, learning, and excellence within the team.

Education and Experience:

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), Psychology, Cognitive Science, or a related field.

• 8+ years of experience in UX research, preferably within the gaming or interactive entertainment industry.

• Proven track record of conducting research for AAA or live-service games.

• Proficiency in qualitative and quantitative research methods, including usability, surveys, interviews, and analytics.

• Experience with UX research tools and platforms.

title: Data Science Intern (Analytics), 6-month internship
description:

title: HR Compliance Associate
description:
Business Unit
The S3 HR and Management Line follows a "User-Focused and Employee-Oriented" philosophy and employs a three-pillar HR organization model. By offering "productized services and marketized management," the S3 HR and Management Line provides comprehensive support for developing Tencent's organization, talent, and culture, enabling employees to grow with the company.

What the Role Entails

About Tencent

Tencent is an Internet-based platform company founded in Shenzhen, China, in 1998. We use technology to enrich the lives of Internet users and assist the digital upgrade of enterprises. Our mission is "Value for Users, Tech for Good". We embrace a culture of teamwork & creativity and are driven by our values - Integrity, Proactivity, Collaboration and Creativity.

We are rapidly expanding our international operations and are looking for top talent to propel us forward. Combining the results-oriented nature of a start-up with the resources of a profitable and leading Internet company, Tencent offers a unique opportunity for aspiring individuals to thrive.

About the Role

As an HR Compliance Associate supporting our Asia Pacific business, you will help ensure that Tencent's people practices meet local employment legislation, statutory obligations and internal governance standards, with a primary focus on Singapore. Working closely with HR colleagues, business leaders and regional stakeholders, you will support employment compliance, HR governance and employee relations casework across a multi-country region, building deep and practical expertise in employment regulation in one of Asia Pacific's most closely regulated markets.

Responsibilities

•
Support compliance with employment legislation and statutory requirements, with a primary focus on Singapore, including the Employment Act, the Employment of Foreign Manpower Act and Ministry of Manpower regulations; partner with country HR colleagues to track regulatory developments and help translate changes into practical process updates.

•
Support employee relations casework under the guidance of senior HR and Legal colleagues, including case intake and triage, evidence and document collation, interview scheduling and note-taking, timeline construction, case file maintenance and follow-up tracking, exercising strict confidentiality, neutrality and consistency of process throughout.

•
Serve as a point of support for employee relations and employment compliance enquiries escalated from employees, managers and HR Business Partners, facilitating resolution and partnering with the business, HR, Legal and other stakeholders to deliver fair and consistent outcomes.

•
Ensure employment documentation and HR records are audit standard, covering employment contracts, Key Employment Terms, policy acknowledgements, disciplinary and grievance records, personnel files and retention schedules, ensuring records are complete, accurate and defensible under review.

•
Support internal and external audits, labour compliance reviews and HR governance activities by assembling evidence, reconciling records against source systems, tracking remediation actions through to closure and documenting outcomes.

•
Support the periodic review, risk assessment and rollout of HR policies across the region, working with legal advisors to ensure local policies remain aligned to both Tencent global standards and country-specific legal requirements.

•
Build and maintain the employee relations and policy knowledge repository, and support the development of manager training materials on fair employment practices, grievance handling and proper documentation.

•
Identify control gaps and propose practical improvements, including better use of HR case management and workflow systems to reduce manual handling and strengthen compliance tracking.

Who We Look For

Requirements

•
Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business, Law, Psychology or a related discipline.

•
Approximately 1–3 years of experience in Human Resources, People Operations, employee relations or employment compliance. Outstanding fresh graduates with relevant internship experience are also encouraged to apply.

•
Familiarity with Singapore employment legislation and fair employment practices is a strong advantage. A genuine interest in employment regulation and the willingness to build real depth in this area is essential.

•
High emotional intelligence and interpersonal maturity, with the ability to handle sensitive situations with professionalism, confidentiality and empathy, and to build trust with employees and stakeholders from diverse backgrounds.

•
Analytical and meticulous, able to conduct precise fact-gathering, maintain accurate records and translate complex data into clear, actionable insights.

•
Exceptionally detail-oriented, with a strong sense of accountability, integrity and discretion, and the discipline to meet deadlines and produce work that withstands audit scrutiny.

•
Comfortable working with HR systems and data, able to build and maintain trackers and case records, reconcile information across sources and use technology to improve operational efficiency.

•
An initiative-taking communicator who keeps stakeholders well informed, asks questions, flags risks early and takes ownership beyond assigned responsibilities in a fast-paced, multi-country environment.

Equal Employment Opportunity at Tencent

As an equal opportunity employer, we firmly believe that diverse voices fuel our innovation and allow us to better serve our users and the community. We foster an environment where every employee of Tencent feels supported and inspired to achieve individual and common goals.

LightSpeed Japan Studio is a game development studio dedicated to crafting original AAA action game titles for global audiences. Led by industry veteran Hideaki Itsuno, the studio operates across two locations in Tokyo and Osaka.

The studio offers a flexible and inclusive work environment and actively welcomes game creators who are full of talent and passion for pushing the boundaries of game development.

title: PUBG Mobile Marketing Team Intern
description:
Business Unit
Tencent Games was established in 2003. We are a leading global platform for game development, operations and publishing, and the largest online game community in China.
Tencent Games has developed and operated over 140 games. We provide cross-platform interactive entertainment experience for more than 800 million users in over 201 countries and regions around the world. Meanwhile, we actively promote the development of esports industry, work with global partners to build an open, collaborative and symbiotic industrial ecology, and create high-quality digital life experiences for players.

This role serves as the PUBG Mobile WEU markets focusing on PUBG Mobile WOW (UGC Maps) mode planning, campaign execution, social & community support. •

•
Post-campaign analysis, including execution review, highlights, performance metrics, and key learnings. Organize and manage marketing assets, data, and project documentation.

title: Tencent Cloud - AI Native Cloud Solution Architect (Thailand)
description:
Business Unit
Cloud & Smart Industries Group (CSIG) is responsible for promoting the company's cloud and industry Internet strategy. CSIG explores the interactions between users and industries to create innovative solutions for smart industries via technological advancements such as cloud, AI, and network security. While driving the digitalization of retail, medical, education, transportation and other industries, CSIG helps companies serve users in smarter ways, building a new ecosystem of intelligent industries that connect users and businesses.

What the Role Entails

What You Can Do Here
1. Accelerate your growth with an international perspective, engage with top-tier Southeast Asia customers, and deeply participate in the most cutting-edge AI needs of the Southeast Asia market and the continuously evolving cloud industry solutions.

2. Master the latest cloud product capabilities in a full-stack manner — across IaaS, AI, audio/video, security and other product lines. Through project co-building with Southeast Asia customers, continuously improve human-AI collaboration capability and customer project success efficiency.

3. Work closely with a diverse, excellent team in Southeast Asia, and jointly embark on a rapidly changing high-growth journey.

• Serve as the customer's technical consulting expert. Lead Tencent Cloud pre-sales analysis, bidding document authoring, and customer solution communication, and strive to obtain support from the customer's technical decision-making level.

• Deeply explore and follow up on the landing of customer needs. Combined with Tencent Cloud public cloud, private cloud, container, big data, audio/video, AI and other product capabilities, design technical solutions for Thailand SVIP customers and follow up on delivery, continuously strengthening differentiated competitive advantages.

• Possess an AI-Native perspective, be proficient in Tencent Cloud AI product knowledge and effectively promote it. Use AI capabilities to complete project POCs and demos, accelerate migration and delivery, and monitor SVIP customer business quality.

• Promote scaled business growth in key markets. On a daily basis, collect real feedback and industry common needs from Thailand customers, and drive continuous iteration and optimization of cloud products and AI tools.

Who We Look For

• Bachelor's degree or above; majors in computer science, information technology, telecommunications engineering and other related fields are preferred.

• 5+ years of experience in cloud computing pre-sales or solution-related work, covering pre-sales research, bidding document authoring, POC implementation, delivery acceptance, and other project phases.

• Familiar with mainstream public cloud platforms, such as Tencent Cloud, Alibaba Cloud, AWS, Azure, GCP, etc. Have experience using AI technology to assist and drive projects; familiar with at least one AI Agent application and have effectively applied it in work.

• Extremely strong pressure resistance and resilience. Proactively tackle project technical risks and AI implementation challenges, with no shirking or escaping. Take real business results as the sole orientation, and refuse to stay only at paper-level solutions.

• Excellent cross-cultural communication and collaboration ability; fluent English with no barriers to business communication; adapt to the collaboration rhythm of multi-country teams. Thai language proficiency is preferred.

title: Tencent Cloud – AI & LLM Solution Architect
description:
Business Unit
Cloud & Smart Industries Group (CSIG) is responsible for promoting the company's cloud and industry Internet strategy. CSIG explores the interactions between users and industries to create innovative solutions for smart industries via technological advancements such as cloud, AI, and network security. While driving the digitalization of retail, medical, education, transportation and other industries, CSIG helps companies serve users in smarter ways, building a new ecosystem of intelligent industries that connect users and businesses.

What the Role Entails

Position Overview

Tencent Cloud is seeking an AI & LLM Solution Architect to accelerate the adoption of Tencent Cloud's enterprise AI platform across Europe. This customer-facing technical role combines solution architecture, customer engineering, and hands-on AI implementation to help enterprises design, build, deploy, and scale production-ready AI applications. Leveraging Tencent Cloud TokenHub—a unified AI platform providing access to leading Large Language Models (LLMs), AI Agents, and the Model Context Protocol (MCP) ecosystem—you will work closely with enterprise customers, Product, Engineering, Research, and Commercial teams to bridge business challenges with innovative AI solutions. Beyond solution delivery, you will serve as the technical bridge between customers and Tencent Cloud's AI product organization, translating real-world customer requirements into product enhancements while accelerating enterprise AI adoption. TokenHub provides enterprises and developers with a unified gateway to leading foundation models through a single API, together with enterprise-grade model management, inference, deployment, monitoring, and AI application capabilities. Product Link: https://www.tencentcloud.com/products/tokenhub?from_qcintl=topnav

Responsibilities

•
Partner with enterprise customers to understand business challenges, identify AI transformation opportunities, and design end-to-end AI and LLM solutions leveraging Tencent Cloud TokenHub, leading foundation models, AI Agents, MCP ecosystem, and enterprise AI capabilities.

•
Lead technical discovery workshops, architecture design sessions, Proof-of-Concepts (POCs), technical validation, and production deployment planning to accelerate enterprise AI adoption.

•
Work directly with customer engineering teams throughout implementation and production rollout, troubleshooting complex technical issues and optimizing AI application performance within enterprise production environments.

•
Design scalable enterprise AI architectures utilizing Large Language Models (LLMs), Prompt Engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI Agents, Model Context Protocol (MCP), model fine-tuning, inference optimization, vector databases, API integration, AI workflow orchestration, and cloud-native AI services.

•
Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, and Research teams to translate customer requirements into platform enhancements, improve developer experience, and continuously evolve Tencent Cloud's AI platform through customer-driven feedback.

•
Develop reusable reference architectures, implementation frameworks, sample applications, technical playbooks, and best practices that accelerate enterprise AI adoption across European customers and partners.

•
Support strategic enterprise opportunities by leading technical proposals, architecture reviews, executive presentations, tender responses, and technical due diligence throughout the customer lifecycle.

Who We Look For

•
Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

•
Minimum 2 years of experience in Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), machine learning, AI platforms, cloud computing, software engineering, MLOps, solution architecture, or customer-facing technical consulting.

•
Hands-on experience with modern AI technologies including LLMs, Prompt Engineering, RAG, AI Agents, MCP, model fine-tuning, inference optimization, vector databases, AI orchestration frameworks, API integration, and cloud-native AI architectures.

•
Experience developing or deploying enterprise AI applications on public cloud platforms, with practical knowledge of multi-model AI orchestration, model deployment, inference services, observability, and production operations.

•
Strong customer-facing communication, presentation, analytical, and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex business requirements into scalable AI solutions.

•
Excellent written and spoken English is required. Proficiency in Chinese Mandarin is required to collaborate with China headquarters on product discussions, technical design, and cross-functional initiatives.

•
Self-driven with strong learning agility, curiosity for emerging AI technologies, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced customer-facing environment.

title: HR Compliance Associate
description:
Business Unit
The S3 HR and Management Line follows a "User-Focused and Employee-Oriented" philosophy and employs a three-pillar HR organization model. By offering "productized services and marketized management," the S3 HR and Management Line provides comprehensive support for developing Tencent's organization, talent, and culture, enabling employees to grow with the company.

What the Role Entails

About Tencent

Tencent is an Internet-based platform company founded in Shenzhen, China, in 1998. We use technology to enrich the lives of Internet users and assist the digital upgrade of enterprises. Our mission is "Value for Users, Tech for Good". We embrace a culture of teamwork & creativity and are driven by our values - Integrity, Proactivity, Collaboration and Creativity.

We are rapidly expanding our international operations and are looking for top talent to propel us forward. Combining the results-oriented nature of a start-up with the resources of a profitable and leading Internet company, Tencent offers a unique opportunity for aspiring individuals to thrive.

About the Role

As an HR Compliance Associate supporting our Asia Pacific business, you will help ensure that Tencent's people practices meet local employment legislation, statutory obligations and internal governance standards, with a primary focus on Singapore. Working closely with HR colleagues, business leaders and regional stakeholders, you will support employment compliance, HR governance and employee relations casework across a multi-country region, building deep and practical expertise in employment regulation in one of Asia Pacific's most closely regulated markets.

Responsibilities

•
Support compliance with employment legislation and statutory requirements, with a primary focus on Singapore, including the Employment Act, the Employment of Foreign Manpower Act and Ministry of Manpower regulations; partner with country HR colleagues to track regulatory developments and help translate changes into practical process updates.

•
Support employee relations casework under the guidance of senior HR and Legal colleagues, including case intake and triage, evidence and document collation, interview scheduling and note-taking, timeline construction, case file maintenance and follow-up tracking, exercising strict confidentiality, neutrality and consistency of process throughout.

•
Serve as a point of support for employee relations and employment compliance enquiries escalated from employees, managers and HR Business Partners, facilitating resolution and partnering with the business, HR, Legal and other stakeholders to deliver fair and consistent outcomes.

•
Ensure employment documentation and HR records are audit standard, covering employment contracts, Key Employment Terms, policy acknowledgements, disciplinary and grievance records, personnel files and retention schedules, ensuring records are complete, accurate and defensible under review.

•
Support internal and external audits, labour compliance reviews and HR governance activities by assembling evidence, reconciling records against source systems, tracking remediation actions through to closure and documenting outcomes.

•
Support the periodic review, risk assessment and rollout of HR policies across the region, working with legal advisors to ensure local policies remain aligned to both Tencent global standards and country-specific legal requirements.

•
Build and maintain the employee relations and policy knowledge repository, and support the development of manager training materials on fair employment practices, grievance handling and proper documentation.

•
Identify control gaps and propose practical improvements, including better use of HR case management and workflow systems to reduce manual handling and strengthen compliance tracking.

Who We Look For

Requirements

•
Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business, Law, Psychology or a related discipline.

•
Approximately 1–3 years of experience in Human Resources, People Operations, employee relations or employment compliance. Outstanding fresh graduates with relevant internship experience are also encouraged to apply.

•
Familiarity with Singapore employment legislation and fair employment practices is a strong advantage. A genuine interest in employment regulation and the willingness to build real depth in this area is essential.

•
High emotional intelligence and interpersonal maturity, with the ability to handle sensitive situations with professionalism, confidentiality and empathy, and to build trust with employees and stakeholders from diverse backgrounds.

•
Analytical and meticulous, able to conduct precise fact-gathering, maintain accurate records and translate complex data into clear, actionable insights.

•
Exceptionally detail-oriented, with a strong sense of accountability, integrity and discretion, and the discipline to meet deadlines and produce work that withstands audit scrutiny.

•
Comfortable working with HR systems and data, able to build and maintain trackers and case records, reconcile information across sources and use technology to improve operational efficiency.

•
An initiative-taking communicator who keeps stakeholders well informed, asks questions, flags risks early and takes ownership beyond assigned responsibilities in a fast-paced, multi-country environment.

Equal Employment Opportunity at Tencent

As an equal opportunity employer, we firmly believe that diverse voices fuel our innovation and allow us to better serve our users and the community. We foster an environment where every employee of Tencent feels supported and inspired to achieve individual and common goals.

title: サウンドデザイナー｜Sound Designer
description:

ライトスピード・ジャパンは、世界中のオーディエンス向けにオリジナルのAAA級アクションゲームタイトルの制作に特化しているゲーム開発スタジオです。著名なゲームディレクターとして知られる伊津野英昭（いつの ひであき）が率いる当スタジオは、東京と大阪の2つの拠点で活動しています。

LightSpeed Japan Studio is a game development studio dedicated to crafting original AAA action game titles for global audiences. Led by industry veteran Hideaki Itsuno, the studio operates across two locations in Tokyo and Osaka.

The studio offers a flexible and inclusive work environment and actively welcomes game creators who are full of talent and passion for pushing the boundaries of game development.

仕事内容/What the Role Entails

仕事内容

・ゲームの世界観や演出意図に基づく、効果音・環境音・BGM・ダイアログ等のサウンド設計および制作

・企画、エンジニア、アニメーション、シナリオ等の関連セクションとの連携および仕様調整

・ダイアログ、音楽等の収録における立ち会いおよびディレクション

・据置コンソール実機上での動作確認、メモリ・CPU負荷を考慮した最適化

・サウンドアセットの管理ルール、オーディオパイプラインおよび制作ワークフローの構築・改善

・ミキシング、マスタリングを含むゲーム全体のサウンド品質の調整・管理

・Unreal Engine 上でのゲームサウンド実装の実務経験

・業務委託先（外部サウンドクリエイター・スタジオ）の進行管理・ディレクション経験

・スケジュール・タスク・（必要に応じて）予算の管理経験

・日本語で円滑なコミュニケーションがとれる方

歓迎要件（あると望ましい）

・AAAタイトルでのサウンド実装・サウンドマネージャー経験

・複数タイトルでのゲームサウンド制作経験(自身でも効果音・BGM等を制作できる方)

・英語・中国語など日本語以外でのコミュニケーションがとれる方(海外の外注先とのやりとり経験があればなお可)

・Wwise / Unreal 以外のミドルウェア（CRI,FMOD 等）の知見

・PS5／Xbox など据置コンソールでの実機対応・メモリ／CPU最適化の経験 ・オーディオパイプライン・ワークフロー構築の経験

・ダイアログ・ミュージック等のレコーディング立ち合い／ディレクション経験

・ミキシング・マスタリング（MA）等、サウンドエンジニアリングの知識

We are dedicated to delivering engaging and original gaming experiences to a worldwide audience, whenever and wherever they choose to play while building a community that fosters inclusivity, connection, and accessibility. What the Role Entails

1. Develop the overall brand marketing strategy, positioning, and core messaging framework for the AAA driving game product before and after its global launch, ensuring consistent communication of the brand concept across regions worldwide.
2. Lead brand creative work throughout the product's full lifecycle from testing through post-launch, including creative planning and execution for key marketing milestones such as the global first reveal, test-phase promotions, integrated online and offline marketing campaigns, and launch events.
3. Develop a deep understanding of the core console/PC player ecosystem and global driving culture communities, formulate community growth and engagement strategies, maintain relationships with core players, and stimulate the content ecosystem.
4. Continuously track market trends in the driving and open-world racing categories, competitor developments, and player feedback, providing data-driven insights for marketing decisions and product optimization.
5. Collaborate with multiple cross-functional teams, including operations, UA, regional marketing teams, and platform partnership teams, integrate in-game resources with global and regional resources, and drive the quality execution of final solutions.
6. Deeply participate in the development and execution coordination of market strategies in key regions, ensuring localized messaging and precise localization are implemented within a globally consistent brand framework.

Who We Look For

1. Required Experience:
- 5+ years of experience in game industry marketing or brand roles.
- Proven experience successfully leading AAA console/PC game brand projects; candidates with experience in open-world, driving/racing, or RPG projects are preferred.
- Global market GTM marketing experience, with familiarity with player ecosystems in at least 2 regional markets (North America/Europe/Asia).
2. Core Competencies
- Deep understanding of driving culture and player psychology: Understands the appeal of automotive culture and the driving experience, and can accurately grasp the community language, emotional needs, and behavioral patterns of driving game players.
- Fluent English: Near-native written and spoken English proficiency, with the ability to independently write English brand copy and creative briefs, understand the vision of overseas studios, and communicate seamlessly with international teams and overseas partners.
- Passion for games: Hardcore gamer with a deep understanding of the console/PC gaming ecosystem and familiarity with the full lifecycle of AAA game launch marketing. Hands-on experience with driving/racing games is preferred.
- Strategy and creativity: Possesses both systematic brand strategy thinking and sharp creative judgment, with the ability to lead end-to-end marketing output.
3. Preferred Qualifications
- Experience in co-marketing with console platform partners is preferred.
- Ability to collaborate with regional marketing teams and support coordination with overseas regional markets.
- Automotive brand cross-over partnership experience or automotive media/KOL resources are preferred; experience in creator community operations or UGC content ecosystems is also preferred.
4. Personal Attributes
- Strong execution and drive: Self-motivated, skilled at cross-department coordination, and capable of driving complex projects to completion across multicultural, multi-time-zone teams.

Position Overview

Tencent Cloud is seeking an AI & LLM Solution Architect to accelerate the adoption of Tencent Cloud's enterprise AI platform across Europe. This customer-facing technical role combines solution architecture, customer engineering, and hands-on AI implementation to help enterprises design, build, deploy, and scale production-ready AI applications. Leveraging Tencent Cloud TokenHub—a unified AI platform providing access to leading Large Language Models (LLMs), AI Agents, and the Model Context Protocol (MCP) ecosystem—you will work closely with enterprise customers, Product, Engineering, Research, and Commercial teams to bridge business challenges with innovative AI solutions. •
Partner with enterprise customers to understand business challenges, identify AI transformation opportunities, and design end-to-end AI and LLM solutions leveraging Tencent Cloud TokenHub, leading foundation models, AI Agents, MCP ecosystem, and enterprise AI capabilities.

•
Lead technical discovery workshops, architecture design sessions, Proof-of-Concepts (POCs), technical validation, and production deployment planning to accelerate enterprise AI adoption.

•
Work directly with customer engineering teams throughout implementation and production rollout, troubleshooting complex technical issues and optimizing AI application performance within enterprise production environments.

Design scalable enterprise AI architectures utilizing Large Language Models (LLMs), Prompt Engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI Agents, Model Context Protocol (MCP), model fine-tuning, inference optimization, vector databases, API integration, AI workflow orchestration, and cloud-native AI services.

Who We Look For

•
Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

•
Minimum 2 years of experience in Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), machine learning, AI platforms, cloud computing, software engineering, MLOps, solution architecture, or customer-facing technical consulting.

•
Hands-on experience with modern AI technologies including LLMs, Prompt Engineering, RAG, AI Agents, MCP, model fine-tuning, inference optimization, vector databases, AI orchestration frameworks, API integration, and cloud-native AI architectures.

Experience developing or deploying enterprise AI applications on public cloud platforms, with practical knowledge of multi-model AI orchestration, model deployment, inference services, observability, and production operations.

Strong customer-facing communication, presentation, analytical, and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex business requirements into scalable AI solutions.

title: Senior User Researcher
description:

We are dedicated to delivering engaging and original gaming experiences to a worldwide audience, whenever and wherever they choose to play while building a community that fosters inclusivity, connection, and accessibility. The Senior UX Researcher (Astra) will lead user experience research initiatives to support the growth and success of Interactive Entertainment Group Global (IEEG) invested game studios in North America and Europe, and possibly in other regions. This role will ensure that player insights are integrated into game design and development processes, driving player satisfaction and business growth. The Senior UX Researcher will collaborate closely with partnered studios, Shenzhen-based partner teams, and IEG and IEGG support functions, such as iMur, Checkpoint and other support departments and vendors.

UX Research Leadership:

• Collaborate with game designers, product managers, and developers to translate research findings into actionable design recommendations.

Global Perspective:

• Share knowledge about UX best practices throughout IEGG.

• Foster a culture of collaboration, learning, and excellence within the team.

Who We Look For

Education and Experience:

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), Psychology, Cognitive Science, or a related field.

• 8+ years of experience in UX research, preferably within the gaming or interactive entertainment industry.

• Proven track record of conducting research for AAA or live-service games.

Technical Skills:

• Proficiency in qualitative and quantitative research methods, including usability, surveys, interviews, and analytics.

• Experience with UX research tools and platforms.

Soft Skills:

• Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey complex research findings to diverse stakeholders.

title: HR Compliance Associate
description:
Business Unit
The S3 HR and Management Line follows a "User-Focused and Employee-Oriented" philosophy and employs a three-pillar HR organization model. By offering "productized services and marketized management," the S3 HR and Management Line provides comprehensive support for developing Tencent's organization, talent, and culture, enabling employees to grow with the company.

What the Role Entails

About Tencent

Tencent is an Internet-based platform company founded in Shenzhen, China, in 1998. We use technology to enrich the lives of Internet users and assist the digital upgrade of enterprises. Our mission is "Value for Users, Tech for Good". We embrace a culture of teamwork & creativity and are driven by our values - Integrity, Proactivity, Collaboration and Creativity.

We are rapidly expanding our international operations and are looking for top talent to propel us forward. Combining the results-oriented nature of a start-up with the resources of a profitable and leading Internet company, Tencent offers a unique opportunity for aspiring individuals to thrive.

About the Role

As an HR Compliance Associate supporting our Asia Pacific business, you will help ensure that Tencent's people practices meet local employment legislation, statutory obligations and internal governance standards, with a primary focus on Singapore. Working closely with HR colleagues, business leaders and regional stakeholders, you will support employment compliance, HR governance and employee relations casework across a multi-country region, building deep and practical expertise in employment regulation in one of Asia Pacific's most closely regulated markets.

Responsibilities

•
Support compliance with employment legislation and statutory requirements, with a primary focus on Singapore, including the Employment Act, the Employment of Foreign Manpower Act and Ministry of Manpower regulations; partner with country HR colleagues to track regulatory developments and help translate changes into practical process updates.

•
Support employee relations casework under the guidance of senior HR and Legal colleagues, including case intake and triage, evidence and document collation, interview scheduling and note-taking, timeline construction, case file maintenance and follow-up tracking, exercising strict confidentiality, neutrality and consistency of process throughout.

•
Serve as a point of support for employee relations and employment compliance enquiries escalated from employees, managers and HR Business Partners, facilitating resolution and partnering with the business, HR, Legal and other stakeholders to deliver fair and consistent outcomes.

•
Ensure employment documentation and HR records are audit standard, covering employment contracts, Key Employment Terms, policy acknowledgements, disciplinary and grievance records, personnel files and retention schedules, ensuring records are complete, accurate and defensible under review.

•
Support internal and external audits, labour compliance reviews and HR governance activities by assembling evidence, reconciling records against source systems, tracking remediation actions through to closure and documenting outcomes.

•
Support the periodic review, risk assessment and rollout of HR policies across the region, working with legal advisors to ensure local policies remain aligned to both Tencent global standards and country-specific legal requirements.

•
Build and maintain the employee relations and policy knowledge repository, and support the development of manager training materials on fair employment practices, grievance handling and proper documentation.

•
Identify control gaps and propose practical improvements, including better use of HR case management and workflow systems to reduce manual handling and strengthen compliance tracking.

Who We Look For

Requirements

•
Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business, Law, Psychology or a related discipline.

•
Approximately 1–3 years of experience in Human Resources, People Operations, employee relations or employment compliance. Outstanding fresh graduates with relevant internship experience are also encouraged to apply.

•
Familiarity with Singapore employment legislation and fair employment practices is a strong advantage. A genuine interest in employment regulation and the willingness to build real depth in this area is essential.

•
High emotional intelligence and interpersonal maturity, with the ability to handle sensitive situations with professionalism, confidentiality and empathy, and to build trust with employees and stakeholders from diverse backgrounds.

•
Analytical and meticulous, able to conduct precise fact-gathering, maintain accurate records and translate complex data into clear, actionable insights.

•
Exceptionally detail-oriented, with a strong sense of accountability, integrity and discretion, and the discipline to meet deadlines and produce work that withstands audit scrutiny.

•
Comfortable working with HR systems and data, able to build and maintain trackers and case records, reconcile information across sources and use technology to improve operational efficiency.

•
An initiative-taking communicator who keeps stakeholders well informed, asks questions, flags risks early and takes ownership beyond assigned responsibilities in a fast-paced, multi-country environment.

Equal Employment Opportunity at Tencent

As an equal opportunity employer, we firmly believe that diverse voices fuel our innovation and allow us to better serve our users and the community. We foster an environment where every employee of Tencent feels supported and inspired to achieve individual and common goals.

title: サウンドデザイナー｜Sound Designer
description:

LightSpeed Japan Studio is a game development studio dedicated to crafting original AAA action game titles for global audiences. Led by industry veteran Hideaki Itsuno, the studio operates across two locations in Tokyo and Osaka.

The studio offers a flexible and inclusive work environment and actively welcomes game creators who are full of talent and passion for pushing the boundaries of game development.

仕事内容/What the Role Entails

title: PUBG Mobile Marketing Team Intern

Tencent Games has developed and operated over 140 games. We provide cross-platform interactive entertainment experience for more than 800 million users in over 201 countries and regions around the world. Honor of Kings, PUBG MOBILE, and League of Legends, are some of our most popular titles around the world.
Meanwhile, we actively promote the development of esports industry, work with global partners to build an open, collaborative and symbiotic industrial ecology, and create high-quality digital life experiences for players.

What the Role Entails
This role serves as the PUBG Mobile WEU markets focusing on PUBG Mobile WOW (UGC Maps) mode planning, campaign execution, social & community support. The position supports WOW Mode planning and related local market projects, deeply understands mobile shooter & Gen Z users, and collaborates cross-team to drive social amplification, performance tracking, and business growth for PUBG Mobile in WEU region.

•
Support the gameplay promotion planning for PUBG Mobile’s WOW module, conduct regular alignment and communication with headquarter, oversee creator partnership programs, and deliver actionable suggestions for map‑mechanics planning to optimize module popularity among Western‑European players.

•
Assist on execution of marketing campaigns in the Western Europe market and coordinate with external vendors, including assisting in creative scripts and content production, participating in on-site execution for shootings or offline activities when required, to ensure all content aligns closely with in-game features and matches local user preferences.

•
Post-campaign analysis, including execution review, highlights, performance metrics, and key learnings. Organize and manage marketing assets, data, and project documentation.

•
Support procurement processes, including vendor contracting and quotation follow-ups and documentation.

Who We Look For

• Passionate about gaming, familiar with battle royale or shooter mobile games.

• Undergraduate or postgraduate student majoring in Marketing, Communication, Gaming, Business, or related fields.

• Strong execution skills with good communication, coordination, and reporting abilities; detail-oriented and responsible.

title: HR Compliance Associate
description:
Business Unit
The S3 HR and Management Line follows a "User-Focused and Employee-Oriented" philosophy and employs a three-pillar HR organization model. By offering "productized services and marketized management," the S3 HR and Management Line provides comprehensive support for developing Tencent's organization, talent, and culture, enabling employees to grow with the company.

What the Role Entails

About Tencent

Tencent is an Internet-based platform company founded in Shenzhen, China, in 1998. We use technology to enrich the lives of Internet users and assist the digital upgrade of enterprises. Our mission is "Value for Users, Tech for Good". We embrace a culture of teamwork & creativity and are driven by our values - Integrity, Proactivity, Collaboration and Creativity.

We are rapidly expanding our international operations and are looking for top talent to propel us forward. Combining the results-oriented nature of a start-up with the resources of a profitable and leading Internet company, Tencent offers a unique opportunity for aspiring individuals to thrive.

About the Role

As an HR Compliance Associate supporting our Asia Pacific business, you will help ensure that Tencent's people practices meet local employment legislation, statutory obligations and internal governance standards, with a primary focus on Singapore. Working closely with HR colleagues, business leaders and regional stakeholders, you will support employment compliance, HR governance and employee relations casework across a multi-country region, building deep and practical expertise in employment regulation in one of Asia Pacific's most closely regulated markets.

Responsibilities

•
Support compliance with employment legislation and statutory requirements, with a primary focus on Singapore, including the Employment Act, the Employment of Foreign Manpower Act and Ministry of Manpower regulations; partner with country HR colleagues to track regulatory developments and help translate changes into practical process updates.

•
Support employee relations casework under the guidance of senior HR and Legal colleagues, including case intake and triage, evidence and document collation, interview scheduling and note-taking, timeline construction, case file maintenance and follow-up tracking, exercising strict confidentiality, neutrality and consistency of process throughout.

•
Serve as a point of support for employee relations and employment compliance enquiries escalated from employees, managers and HR Business Partners, facilitating resolution and partnering with the business, HR, Legal and other stakeholders to deliver fair and consistent outcomes.

•
Ensure employment documentation and HR records are audit standard, covering employment contracts, Key Employment Terms, policy acknowledgements, disciplinary and grievance records, personnel files and retention schedules, ensuring records are complete, accurate and defensible under review.

•
Support internal and external audits, labour compliance reviews and HR governance activities by assembling evidence, reconciling records against source systems, tracking remediation actions through to closure and documenting outcomes.

•
Support the periodic review, risk assessment and rollout of HR policies across the region, working with legal advisors to ensure local policies remain aligned to both Tencent global standards and country-specific legal requirements.

•
Build and maintain the employee relations and policy knowledge repository, and support the development of manager training materials on fair employment practices, grievance handling and proper documentation.

•
Identify control gaps and propose practical improvements, including better use of HR case management and workflow systems to reduce manual handling and strengthen compliance tracking.

Who We Look For

Requirements

•
Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business, Law, Psychology or a related discipline.

•
Approximately 1–3 years of experience in Human Resources, People Operations, employee relations or employment compliance. Outstanding fresh graduates with relevant internship experience are also encouraged to apply.

•
Familiarity with Singapore employment legislation and fair employment practices is a strong advantage. A genuine interest in employment regulation and the willingness to build real depth in this area is essential.

•
High emotional intelligence and interpersonal maturity, with the ability to handle sensitive situations with professionalism, confidentiality and empathy, and to build trust with employees and stakeholders from diverse backgrounds.

•
Analytical and meticulous, able to conduct precise fact-gathering, maintain accurate records and translate complex data into clear, actionable insights.

•
Exceptionally detail-oriented, with a strong sense of accountability, integrity and discretion, and the discipline to meet deadlines and produce work that withstands audit scrutiny.

•
Comfortable working with HR systems and data, able to build and maintain trackers and case records, reconcile information across sources and use technology to improve operational efficiency.

•
An initiative-taking communicator who keeps stakeholders well informed, asks questions, flags risks early and takes ownership beyond assigned responsibilities in a fast-paced, multi-country environment.

Equal Employment Opportunity at Tencent

As an equal opportunity employer, we firmly believe that diverse voices fuel our innovation and allow us to better serve our users and the community. We foster an environment where every employee of Tencent feels supported and inspired to achieve individual and common goals.

title: Marketing Manager
description:

岗位职责

1. IP品牌策略与传播 —— 负责成熟游戏产品的IP品牌建设与用户口碑营销，基于产品核心卖点与用户画像，制定市场发行策略，主导创意构思并推动高质量落地执行；

5. 整合营销与效果度量 —— 拆解整合营销全链路，搭建可量化的效果追踪体系与评估标准，结合内容数据复盘与分析，持续迭代发行策略与执行手段。

岗位要求

1. 本科及以上学历，市场营销、广告传播、心理学或游戏相关专业优先；
2. 5年以上游戏行业市场营销经验，至少主导过1款产品的全案传播及IP联动项目，有成熟案例可展示；
3. 市场嗅觉敏锐，深谙抖音、B站、小红书等平台的内容生态与流量机制，有爆款创意内容或事件营销的成功操盘经验者优先；
4. 熟悉主流AI大模型及效率工具，能将其有效嵌入发行工作流并持续优化提效，对AI赋能营销有实际应用经验；
5. 数据驱动、结果导向，具备复杂问题的拆解、定位与解决能力，善于从执行数据中发现趋势或风险，推动策略调整与落地；
6. 出色的跨部门沟通与项目管理能力，既能深入理解用户视角与诉求，也能高效推进组织内外多方协作，确保项目闭环。

title: Financial Accounting and Analysis Intern
description:
Business Unit
At Tencent Finance, we are deeply committed to fostering the professional growth of our staff through tailored finance training, mentorship programs, job rotation initiatives, and support for finance professional certifications. Recognized as an approved employer by esteemed organizations like ACCA, HKICPA, CIMA, CPA Australia, and CA, and certified accredited trainer with the Singapore Accountancy Commission, we provide comprehensive resources and guidance to ensure our employees remain at the forefront of the rapidly evolving finance landscape. Join our dynamic Tencent Finance team as Financial Accounting and Analysis Intern where you'll have the opportunity to immerse yourself in real-world accounting and financial practices. You will be having the exposure to the end-to-end accounting and finance processes, focusing either on General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable and Finance Operations, offering you tailored hands-on experience in the complex commercial and business environment. • Support Accounts Receivable (AR) activities by assisting in customer invoicing, tracking payments, and managing overdue receivables.

• Collaborate with teams to streamline Finance Operations, helping to enhance process efficiency and support financial audits by preparing relevant documentation.

• Ensure compliance with company policies and accounting standards, contributing to continuous improvements across finance functions.

Who We Look For

•
Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Accountancy or a related discipline.

•
Able to commit to a full-time internship for 4-6 months from November 2026/January 2027 onwards.

•
Demonstrated ability to apply accounting knowledge in practical scenarios, particularly in identifying and resolving issues.

•
Strong analytical and presentation skills.

•
Excellent written and spoken English required. Working proficiency in Mandarin required, as approximately 80% of the role involves coordinating with Mandarin-speaking stakeholders and regional teams.
