Level Infinite 是腾讯旗下国际游戏业务品牌，致力为全球玩家带来充满乐趣、原汁原味的游戏体验，让玩家随时随地进入游戏世界；并通过打造包容、互通、便捷的玩家社区，促进分享交流。

Level Infinite为合作工作室提供一系列支持及服务，助力其释放产品潜能。

Level Infinite发行产品包括《PUBG MOBILE》、《Goddess of Victory: NIKKE 》《Honor of King》等热门游戏，并与合作工作室联手推出了来自Fatshark的《战锤40K：暗潮》、Funcom的《沙丘：觉醒》、Inflexion Studios的《夜莺》在内多款产品。

想进一步了解Level Infinite，请访问www.levelinfinite.com，并在Twitter、Facebook、Instagram和Youtube上关注我们的官方账号。

岗位职责

1、AI Copilot 系统研发：负责本地化 AI Copilot 系统的架构设计与核心代码编写，实现 AI 辅助翻译、术语推荐、译后编辑（PE）等功能。

2、向量检索与 RAG 落地：负责向量数据库（Vector DB）的选型、搭建与优化；利用检索增强生成（RAG）技术，将现有的翻译记忆库（TM）和术语库（TB）转化为向量，实现高召回、高精准的上下文检索。

3、主流大模型（LLM）接入与性能优化：负责将 Google Cloud（Vertex AI / Gemini）、OpenAI、Claude 等海外主流 AI 模型，通过 API 高效、稳定地接入公司现有的本地化作业平台与 CAT 自动化流水线；并解决大模型调用中的高并发、高延迟、API 限流等问题，优化 Token 消耗成本。

4、Prompt 工程与调优：主导面向多语种（特别是复杂语种，如韩语、泰语、缅甸语、西语等）的 Prompt 设计、微调与评估；通过 Few-shot、COT、Structured Output 等技术，确保 AI 翻译在字数限制、标签（Tag）保留、语气风格上达到工业级游戏本地化标准。

5、本地化 TMS 系统开发与运维：负责本地化 TMS 系统的新特性开发与已有功能的维护、性能优化，实现本地化流程自动化和全球应用。

6、本地化业务支持：理解游戏本地化流程与实践，利用 AI 与工具能力持续优化本地化效率与质量；后续可负责一到多款游戏的多语言本地化，与上游研发团队和发行团队沟通、制定整体本地化计划与预算、交付符合质量要求的本地化多语言版本。

岗位要求

1、本科及以上学历，计算机、语言类、本地化或相关专业，有3年以上实际开发经验。扎实的编程能力，熟练掌握 Python / Go / Node.js 中的至少一种开发语言，具备良好的编码规范。

2、大模型开发经验：熟悉 LangChain、LlamaIndex 等主流 LLM 开发框架，有实际的大模型 API（如 Google Vertex AI, OpenAI）对接与工程化落地经验。

3、向量数据库经验：熟悉至少一种向量数据库（如 Milvus, Qdrant, Pinecone, Chroma），理解向量嵌入（Embedding）原理，有 RAG 系统调优经验者优先；同事具备优秀的Prompt 能力，对 Prompt Engineering 有深入理解，能够熟练编写结构化 Prompt，并能通过自动评估或评测集不断迭代 Prompt 效果。

4、游戏本地化认知：了解游戏端内外内容的本地化流程和实践，有游戏本地化版本成功交付经验者优先；熟悉翻译、审校、 配音或LQA流程，对游戏本地化有独到的见解，善于利用工具和 AI 能力持续优化本地化效率和质量。

5、熟悉本地化业务：熟悉翻译记忆库（TMX）、术语表（TBX）、CAT 工具；具备MS office等本地化行业常见文档格式处理能力和经验者优先。

6、英语能力：书面或口头交流顺畅，能快速阅读英文技术文档，并与海外团队、供应商顺畅沟通。

title: Business Development Intern (Open)
description:
部署紹介/Business Unit
全世界で12億人以上のユーザーを誇る WeChat は、中国と世界中の人々、サービス、企業をつなぎ、モバイルの未来を大きく変革しています。海外市場で WeChat Pay として知られる Weixin Pay は、2013年にWeixinによって導入されたモバイル決済ソリューションです。銀行口座と Weixin Pay アカウントを連携させることで、ユーザーは迅速かつ便利で、安全な決済や取引をスムーズに完了できます。
中国国内では、Weixin Pay は日常生活のあらゆる場面に溶け込み、オンラインまたはオフラインを問わず、小売、飲食、交通、ヘルスケア、レジャーといったさまざまな分野で、効率的かつスマートな決済サービスを提供しています。日本においては、WeChat Pay チームが日本市場全体でのサービス拡大に尽力しています。

With over 1.2 billion users worldwide, WeChat is changing the mobile landscape by connecting people, services, and businesses in China and around-the world. Weixin Pay, referred to as WeChat Pay in overseas markets, is a mobile payment solution jointly launched by Weixin in 2013. After bundling their Weixin Pay accounts with bank cards, Weixin Pay users can pay and complete transactions in a fast, convenient, and secure manner.
In China, Weixin Pay touches almost every aspect of everyday life, providing both online and offline services and giving users a highly efficient and intelligent payment experience, particularly in retail, dining, transportation, healthcare and leisure, and more. The WeChat Pay team in Japan is responsible for its increasing in all aspects of Japanese markets.

仕事内容/What the Role Entails

- ビジネスオペレーション（Business Operations）：Business Development（BD）チームと連携し、顧客関係の強化およびビジネス機会の開拓を推進。

- Key Account（KA）加盟店・機関と連携し、導入、販促物、キャンペーン施策等の推進を行う。

- 市場調査（Market Research）：以下を含むが、これらに限定されない。A. 店舗巡回（Store Inspection）：オフライン店舗を訪問し、販促物の設置状況を確認。B. 市場動向調査（Market Dynamics）：オンライン調査、業界レポート、現地訪問を通じて重要な市場情報を定期的に収集し、決済エコシステムの健全性を評価・比較。C. ユーザー調査（User Research）：現地訪問やオンラインアンケートを通じて、ユーザー浸透率およびユーザー体験に関するデータを収集。

- 販促物展開（Material Deployment）：機関側ではカバーが難しいエリアやシーンに対して、現地での販促物設置を実施。

- 協業開拓（Collaboration Exploration）：大学サークルや主要商業エリア等との連携を推進し、ユーザーコミュニティ向けマーケティング浸透を実施。現地で消費行動を観察し、調査・データ分析を行いながら、WeChatエコシステム内での協業機会を探索。

- 高い主体性とセルフマネジメント能力を持ち、自律的かつ積極的に業務を推進・完遂できる

賃金
年収額：応相談（昇給/賞与あり）

完全週休２日制（土日・祝日）

健康保険 、雇用保険、 労災保険、 厚生年金保険、 総合福祉団体定期保険（GTL）
業務災害安心総合保険（GPA）、団体長期障害所得補償保険（GLTD）

About the Hiring Team
Level Infinite is Tencent’s global gaming brand. It is a global game publisher offering a comprehensive network of services for games, development teams, and studios around the world.

We are dedicated to delivering engaging and original gaming experiences to a worldwide audience, whenever and wherever they choose to play while building a community that fosters inclusivity, connection, and accessibility. Level Infinite also provides a wide range of services and resources to our network of developers and partner studios around the world to help them unlock the true potential of their games.

What the Role Entails
We are seeking a driven and culturally savvy Marketing Manager to lead go-to-market efforts for our flagship global gaming titles, with a primary focus on the MENA region. In this role, you will craft and execute data-informed marketing strategies that reflect regional market dynamics, local user behavior, cultural calendars, and product release milestones — all in service of growing brand equity, user engagement, and positive community sentiment, while hitting regional publishing targets.
1. Regional Marketing & Campaign Execution

•
Lead user insight gathering, selling-point articulation, and creative marketing planning for key global titles.

•
Drive end-to-end campaign delivery aligned with version updates, local festivals, and brand marketing needs — managing timelines, asset preparation, resource coordination, and execution tracking to ensure on-time, on-brief completion.

•
Collaborate with internal creative, product, and business development teams to align global brand strategy with local market execution.

2. KOL, Creator & Community Ecosystem

•
KOL & Creator Sourcing: Identify, outreach, onboard, and maintain relationships with a diverse pool of regional KOLs, KOL vendors/agencies, and micro-creators across platforms (YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Twitch).

•
Briefing & Quality Control: Develop clear, platform-native creative briefs for influencers and agencies; review content deliverables for brand alignment, quality, and compliance.

•
Incentive & Growth Programs: Iterate on localized creator incentive frameworks (tiered rewards, affiliate programs, early-access perks) to boost content volume, quality, and conversion efficiency.

•
Community Support & Management: Partner with community managers to nurture official and grassroots player communities across Discord, Reddit, WhatsApp, and regional social platforms. Ensure timely response loops, sentiment tracking, and escalation protocols are in place.

•
Vendor Management: Own relationships with KOL agencies and influencer marketing platforms — negotiate contracts, track performance KPIs (CPM, CPV, engagement rate, conversion), and optimize spend across campaigns.

3. Local Events & Cross-Industry Partnerships

•
Support regional event delivery (esports tournaments, fan meetups, launch parties, convention appearances) in coordination with global HQ and local partners.

•
Identify and execute brand/IP crossover opportunities, connecting internal and external resources to ensure efficient cross-team collaboration and deal closure.

4. Market Intelligence & Localization Insights

•
Maintain a continuous pulse on regional social media ecosystems (TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Snapchat), emerging platform trends, player preferences, and competitor activity.

•
Translate cultural and platform insights into actionable, compliance-aware creative recommendations for the broader marketing team.

•
Proactively build understanding of MENA-specific cultural norms, religious sensitivities (e.g. Ramadan, Eid), content regulations, and platform policies.

5. Content Ecosystem & Scalable Production

•
Explore lightweight, scalable content production models — including UGC campaigns, AI-assisted content tools, and template-driven workflows — to lower creative barriers for players and micro-creators.

•
Repurpose and localize English-language assets for regional audiences; identify and amplify high-performing local KOC (Key Opinion Consumer) content to fuel regional growth.

Who We Look For

Education & Experience

•
Bachelor’s degree or above.

•
5+ years of experience in gaming marketing, global publishing, or related fields.

•
Experience with global publishing or emerging markets (especially MENA) is a strong plus.

Language

•
English: Professional working proficiency — must be able to lead meetings, write briefs, and collaborate cross-culturally in English.

•
Arabic: A significant advantage, but not required.

Gaming Literacy

•
Deep passion for the gaming industry. Must have hands-on experience with at least 3–6 major mobile, PC, or console titles.

•
In-depth experience with GTA-like or open-world action titles is highly preferred.

Core Competencies

•
Collaboration & Communication: Strong team player with excellent cross-functional and cross-cultural communication skills.

•
Project Management: Proven ability to manage multiple campaigns simultaneously; detail-oriented while maintaining a big-picture view.

•
Resilience & Drive: Self-starter with high accountability, strong execution capability, and the ability to thrive under pressure.

•
Market Acumen: Sharp market instincts, rapid learning agility, and a bias toward data-informed decision-making.

•
Cultural Compliance Awareness: Willingness and ability to learn regional cultural, religious, and regulatory nuances — particularly for the MENA region — and apply them to marketing practice.

Equal Employment Opportunity at Tencent

As an equal opportunity employer, we firmly believe that diverse voices fuel our innovation and allow us to better serve our users and the community. We foster an environment where every employee of Tencent feels supported and inspired to achieve individual and common goals.

title: 预装渠道运营
description:
团队介绍
Level Infinite 是腾讯旗下国际游戏业务品牌，致力为全球玩家带来充满乐趣、原汁原味的游戏体验，让玩家随时随地进入游戏世界；并通过打造包容、互通、便捷的玩家社区，促进分享交流。

Level Infinite为合作工作室提供一系列支持及服务，助力其释放产品潜能。

Level Infinite发行产品包括《PUBG MOBILE》、《Goddess of Victory: NIKKE 》《Honor of King》等热门游戏，并与合作工作室联手推出了来自Fatshark的《战锤40K：暗潮》、Funcom的《沙丘：觉醒》、Inflexion Studios的《夜莺》在内多款产品。

想进一步了解Level Infinite，请访问www.levelinfinite.com，并在Twitter、Facebook、Instagram和Youtube上关注我们的官方账号。

岗位职责

1. 渠道拓展：开拓海外头部手机厂商（传音、小米、三星、OPPO/VIVO 等）的预装资源，包括装机必备文件夹、小游戏中心、系统桌面负一屏、出厂默认推荐位等核心坑位，并维护长期合作关系；
2. 商务模式：针对休闲游戏 LTV 较低的特点主导商务谈判，设计并跑通 CPA、CPD及广告收益分成等合作模型，控制单激活成本；
3. 技术落地：协同技术团队推进 Stub 、即玩、云游戏微端在厂商端的系统级应用，保障低配机型与弱网环境下用户也能秒级激活；
4. 归因管理：负责对接并精细化配置主流 MMP，主导制定 Stub 包激活、延迟激活等场景的归因规则；
5. 数据清洗与反作弊：建立数据清洗机制，通过首次联网时间、机型激活时差、行为特征等维度，剔除预装对自然量及线上买量渠道的归因污染与重复计费；建立反作弊监控模型，识别设备农场、GAID/IMEI 篡改、点击劫持等作弊流量；
6. 工具建设：协同 BI 打通厂商后台激活数据、MMP、自建日志与广告变现数据，输出预装渠道专属 ROI、LTV 曲线、回本周期的看板；

岗位要求

1. 5 年以上海外游戏发行/运营经验，其中至少 2 年聚焦休闲游戏（消除、解谜、合成、超休闲等）的 OEM 厂商预装、云预装或游戏联运运营；
2. 精通主流 MMP的预装归因底层逻辑，深刻理解各手机厂商预装激活的统计口径差异；
3. 数据能力扎实，能使用 SQL 独立完成千万级行为数据的筛选、去重与清洗；有 Python（Pandas/NumPy）数据处理或协同 BI 建模经验者加分；
4. 要求具备极强的项目推进能力，能适应多款游戏同时多渠道排期预装的快节奏，能接受定期海外出差；
5. 英语流利，可作为工作语言，能独立完成与海外厂商总部及区域分公司的商务谈判与日常对接。

腾讯致力于提供平等就业机会

在腾讯，我们始终秉承平等就业机会的原则，致力于为每一位员工打造公平、包容的工作环境。我们坚信，多元的声音能够激发出无限的创新活力，推动我们为用户和社会提供更优质的服务。我们用心营造一个充满支持与激励的氛围，帮助每一位员工找到属于自己的舞台，以实现个人及共同的发展目标。

title: Product Manager, WorkBuddy Enterprise — Agent Platform
description:
Business Unit
Cloud & Smart Industries Group (CSIG) is responsible for promoting the company's cloud and industry Internet strategy. CSIG explores the interactions between users and industries to create innovative solutions for smart industries via technological advancements such as cloud, AI, and network security. While driving the digitalization of retail, medical, education, transportation and other industries, CSIG helps companies serve users in smarter ways, building a new ecosystem of intelligent industries that connect users and businesses.

What the Role Entails
The Product Manager, WorkBuddy Enterprise — will own the enterprise roadmap and customer success strategy for the WorkBuddy Enterprise platform, including WorkBuddy, CodeBuddy, and Managed Agents. This role drives the platform’s competitive positioning in the global enterprise AI market, covering the full lifecycle from architectural design to production-grade delivery for key enterprise customers.

• Define and own the enterprise product roadmap and go-to-market strategy for WorkBuddy Enterprise, driving platform competitiveness and customer adoption across international markets while aligning with business growth and commercial targets.

• Lead the ecosystem and integration strategy for enterprise Skills, MCP, and Connector frameworks, enabling seamless interoperability across third-party, customer-built, and ecosystem services to support enterprise agent and digital employee deployments.

• Establish reliability and evaluation (Eval) infrastructure, including eval harnesses, agent safety guardrails, trajectory replay, production telemetry, and automated regression testing, to elevate Proof of Concept success rates to production-grade standards.

• Partner with sales and solutions teams to build a structured key-account delivery system, distilling implementation experience from top enterprise customers into reusable templates and best practices that accelerate time-to-value.

Who We Look For

• At least six years of product management experience, including at least three years in AI platforms, cloud platforms, developer tools, or enterprise SaaS, with a proven track record of independently owning platform products (PaaS, SDK, API, or SaaS) for enterprise customers.

• Demonstrated commercial acumen with hands-on experience across the full product lifecycle, from product definition and design to go-to-market optimisation, including familiarity with ARR, gross margin, net revenue retention (NRR), and paid conversion metrics.

• Deep understanding and practical use of AI and large language model products from providers such as Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, AWS, and Microsoft, together with knowledge of agent orchestration engineering and product design trade-offs.

• Strong enterprise platform knowledge, including SSO, SCIM, RBAC, data residency, tenant isolation, and audit logging, with familiarity with domestic and international security compliance frameworks and certification processes.

title: 3D Artist Intern
description:
About the Hiring Team
Level Infinite is Tencent’s global gaming brand. It is a global game publisher offering a comprehensive network of services for games, development teams, and studios around the world.

We are dedicated to delivering engaging and original gaming experiences to a worldwide audience, whenever and wherever they choose to play while building a community that fosters inclusivity, connection, and accessibility. Level Infinite also provides a wide range of services and resources to our network of developers and partner studios around the world to help them unlock the true potential of their games.

What the Role Entails

•
Responsible for creating high-quality hard-surface game assets, including vehicles, weapons, machinery, sci-fi environment props, and other related objects. Work includes high-poly modeling, low-poly modeling, and UV unwrapping/layout.

•
Responsible for baking normal maps and related texture maps from high-poly models to low-poly models, and creating realistic material and texture effects based on the PBR workflow.

•
Import completed assets into mainstream game engines such as Unreal Engine or Unity, and collaborate with programmers and game designers to restore and adjust the final in-engine visual results.

•
Work with the team to explore how generative AI tools, such as Midjourney and Hunyuan 3D, can be integrated into early- and mid-stage asset production workflows, including concept design support and texture generation assistance.

Who We Look For

• Majors in art, digital media, 3D animation, game design, or related fields are preferred. Outstanding candidates from other backgrounds are also welcome. A personal portfolio is required, including complete hard-surface and PBR works.

• Proficient in at least one mainstream 3D modeling software, such as Maya, 3ds Max, or Blender. Solid foundation in hard-surface modeling, with clean topology, reasonable edge flow, and accurate structural design.

• Proficient in Substance Painter or Mari for PBR material and texture creation, with a strong eye for material qualities such as metal, plastic, paint, wear, scratches, and surface aging.

• Familiar with the complete high-poly to low-poly baking workflow using tools such as Marmoset Toolbag or Substance Painter. Able to accurately preserve high-poly details while maintaining proper low-poly polygon counts and topology structure.

• Familiar with common AI image generation and model design workflows. Able to use AI tools to quickly extract design inspiration, assist in concept sketch generation, or support texture and material creation, such as using Stable Diffusion to enhance detail maps or understanding the basic principles of AI image-to-3D workflows.

• Strong self-learning ability and teamwork spirit. Passionate about emerging technologies, such as virtualized micropolygon geometry technology and AI-assisted production workflows.

Nice to Have

• Proficiency in Blender for efficient hard-surface modeling, including experience with plugins such as HardOps and Boxcutter.

• Hands-on experience integrating assets into Unreal Engine 5 or Unity projects/demos, with basic understanding of material node setup.

• Ability to use Stable Diffusion or Midjourney for controllable image generation, with practical experience integrating AI into production workflows, such as creating seamless textures or developing concept base designs.

• Familiarity with ZBrush sculpting, especially for assets involving both hard-surface and organic elements, or complex surface wear and damage details.

title: Brand Marketing Intern
description:
About the Hiring Team

What the Role Entails

ABOUT LEVEL INFINITE

Level Infinite is Tencent Games' global publishing label, bringing world-class gaming experiences to players across more than 200 countries and regions. We work across a diverse portfolio of games — from action RPGs to casual mobile titles — and are building the brand infrastructure to match our global ambitions. This isn't just a publishing house; it's a brand being built in real time.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a driven, focused intern to join our Brand Marketing team at our Playa Vista office. You'll work together with senior brand and marketing professionals, getting hands-on exposure to how a global gaming brand is built — from influencer campaigns to community activations to live events.

This role sits at the intersection of brand, marketing, and cross-functional collaboration. You'll regularly interface with stakeholders across game teams, partnerships, PR, and regional offices — helping coordinate projects, align on priorities, and keep momentum going. It's a high-exposure position with a real learning curve: you'll see how decisions get made, how campaigns come together, and how a growing global brand operates day to day. If you're someone who thrives in

fast-moving environments, loves gaming culture, and wants to learn the craft of brand-building from the inside, this is your seat at the table.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Support day-to-day coordination across influencer marketing, community, and events campaigns — tracking deliverables, timelines, and partner communications

• Assist in identifying, vetting, and onboarding content creators and influencers across YouTube, TikTok, Twitch, and Instagram

• Help manage community touchpoints including social listening, Discord/Reddit monitoring, and fan engagement initiatives

• Coordinate logistics for online and offline events — including game launches, tournaments, and brand activations

• Draft briefs, recaps, trackers, and decks to support campaign planning and reporting

• Act as a reliable communication bridge between internal stakeholders (Brand, Marketing, Game Teams) and external partners

• Research trends in gaming culture, creator ecosystems, and competitor brand activities to inform strategy

• Shadow senior brand team members across planning sessions, partner calls, and creative reviews

Who We Look For

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

• Currently enrolled in or recently graduated from a Bachelor's or Master's program in Marketing, Communications, Media, Business, or a related field

• Genuine passion for gaming — you follow the industry, know the games, and understand the culture

• Prior experience or coursework in at least one of: influencer/creator marketing, community management, or event coordination (internships, club work, and personal projects all count)

• Highly organized, with a natural instinct for follow-up and keeping projects on track

• Comfortable working across time zones with remote and distributed teams

• Familiarity with tools like Notion, Airtable, Google Workspace, AI Platforms or similar project management/collaboration software is a plus

• A proactive attitude — you ask questions, raise your hand, and bring ideas to the table

NICE TO HAVE

• Active presence in gaming communities (Discord, Reddit, Twitch, etc.) — as a player, mod, or creator

• Experience running or supporting brand social accounts

• Exposure to campaign analytics and reporting (engagement rates, reach, conversion tracking)

WHAT YOU'LL GET

• Real responsibility from day one — not a fetch-coffee internship

• Direct mentorship from experienced brand and marketing professionals

• Front-row access to how a major global gaming brand operates behind the scenes

• Meaningful exposure to cross-functional stakeholders — game teams, PR, partnerships, and regional offices — giving you a full picture of how a global publisher operates

• A portfolio-worthy experience with tangible campaigns and activations to point to

Location State(s)

US-California-Los Angeles, US-California-Palo Alto

The expected base pay range for this position in the location(s) listed above is $24.81 to $42.70 per hour. Actual pay may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.
This position will be eligible for 1 hour of paid sick leave for every 30 hours worked and up to 13 paid holidays throughout the calendar year. title: コンセプトアーティスト｜Concept Artist
description:
チーム紹介/About the Hiring Team
ライトスピード・ジャパンは、世界中のオーディエンス向けにオリジナルのAAA級アクションゲームタイトルの制作に特化しているゲーム開発スタジオです。著名なゲームディレクターとして知られる伊津野英昭（いつの ひであき）が率いる当スタジオは、東京と大阪の2つの拠点で活動しています。

柔軟で包括的な職場環境を提供し、ゲーム制作の限界を押し広げる才能と情熱にあふれるゲームクリエイターの参加を非常に歓迎しています。

LightSpeed Japan Studio is a game development studio dedicated to crafting original AAA action game titles for global audiences. Led by industry veteran Hideaki Itsuno, the studio operates across two locations in Tokyo and Osaka.

The studio offers a flexible and inclusive work environment and actively welcomes game creators who are full of talent and passion for pushing the boundaries of game development.

仕事内容/What the Role Entails

仕事内容

1.  フォトリアルなビジュアルコンセプトの作成

ゲームや映像作品の世界観、キャラクター、背景などのビジュアルコンセプトを作成し、作品全体のビジュアル方向性を視覚的に表現する。

2.  フォトリアルなキャラクターおよびエネミーデザイン

ゲーム内のキャラクターや敵キャラクターのデザインを担当し、キャラクターの性格や背景に基づいて個性的で魅力的なビジュアルを創り上げる。

3.  環境デザインと世界観の構築

ゲーム内のステージや環境、背景アートをデザインし、プレイヤーが没入できる世界観を提供する。

4.  ビジュアルスタイルガイドラインの策定

ゲーム全体のビジュアルスタイルを定め、キャラクター、エフェクト、背景などのアート要素が統一されるようにガイドラインを作成する。

5.  他部門との協力

ゲームデザイナーや3Dアーティストと連携し、ビジュアル要素がゲームプレイに適切に統合されるように調整する。

6.  外部協力会社への発注準備、指定書制作、アートの監修

Job Description

1. Creation of Photorealistic Visual Concepts
Develop visual concepts that express the overall visual direction of games or visual works, including the world, characters, and environments, with a photorealistic style.

2. Photorealistic Character and Enemy Design
Design in-game characters and enemies based on their personality and background, creating unique and visually compelling representations.

3. Environment Design and World-Building
Design in-game stages, environments, and background art to deliver an immersive world that enhances player engagement.

4. Development of Visual Style Guidelines
Establish visual style guidelines for the game to ensure consistency across all art elements, including characters, effects, and backgrounds.

5. Cross-Functional Collaboration
Work closely with game designers and 3D artists to ensure visual elements are well-integrated into the gameplay experience.

6. Art Supervision and Documentation for External Partners
Prepare briefing materials and specifications for outsourcing, and supervise art production by external vendors to maintain quality and consistency.

応募資格/Who We Look For

応募条件

1.  コンセプトアート経験

ゲーム業界でのコンセプトアート経験（AAAタイトル経験者優遇）。キャラクター、環境、エフェクトのデザインに関する豊富な知識と実績。

2.  デザインツールの使用スキル

PhotoshopやIllustratorなどの主要なデザインツールを使いこなすスキル。

3.  3Dアートの基本的理解

3Dソフトウェア（Maya、ZBrushなど）の基本的な知識があり、3Dアートとの連携ができる能力。

4.  チームワークとコミュニケーション能力

他のアーティストやディレクターと円滑に連携し、プロジェクトを進めるための優れたコミュニケーションスキル。

5.  フィードバックへの柔軟な対応

チームメンバーやクライアントからのフィードバックを適切に受け入れ、柔軟に改善・修正できる能力。

Requirements

1. Concept Art Experience
Experience in concept art within the gaming industry (experience with AAA titles is a plus). Strong knowledge and a proven track record in designing characters, environments, and effects.

2. Proficiency with Design Tools
Advanced skills in using major design tools such as Photoshop and Illustrator.

3. Basic Understanding of 3D Art
Fundamental knowledge of 3D software (e.g., Maya, ZBrush) and the ability to collaborate effectively with 3D artists.

4. Teamwork and Communication Skills
Excellent communication skills to work smoothly with other artists and directors, contributing to overall project success.

5. Flexibility in Responding to Feedback
Ability to accept and incorporate feedback from team members and clients with a flexible and constructive attitude.

一緒に働く魅力/Why Join Us?

title: Tencent Cloud Senior Industry Product Operations Manager — Risk Control & Anti-Fraud (Malaysia)
description:
Business Unit
Cloud & Smart Industries Group (CSIG) is responsible for promoting the company's cloud and industry Internet strategy. CSIG explores the interactions between users and industries to create innovative solutions for smart industries via technological advancements such as cloud, AI, and network security. While driving the digitalization of retail, medical, education, transportation and other industries, CSIG helps companies serve users in smarter ways, building a new ecosystem of intelligent industries that connect users and businesses.

What the Role Entails
We are looking for a (Senior) Industry Product Operations Manager with solid experience in risk control, anti-fraud, business security, and financial risk management, as well as strong commercialisation capabilities and bilingual communication skills in native language and English.
This role will be responsible for supporting the commercialisation and solution delivery of Tencent Cloud Risk Control Solution, TCRS, in overseas markets. The position will serve as a critical bridge between product, sales, solution, delivery, and client teams.

The successful candidate will be expected to deeply understand overseas clients’ risk challenges across scenarios such as registration, login, marketing campaigns, transactions, payments, credit application, account security, and user lifecycle management. The candidate will translate Tencent Cloud’s capabilities in business security, risk identification, anti-fraud, device risk, account security, payment risk control, and financial risk management into industry solutions that are sellable, deliverable, and scalable.
This role requires not only strong technical understanding, but also strong business acumen, client communication skills, and solution packaging capabilities. The candidate will support overseas sales teams throughout the full sales cycle, including requirement discovery, solution design, client presentation, product demonstration, POC execution, pricing support, and commercial conversion.
1. Drive Overseas Commercialisation of TCRS

• Lead the solution design and commercial landing of Tencent Cloud TCRS products in overseas markets, covering risk control, anti-fraud, and financial risk management.

• Develop industry-specific solutions for clients in fintech, digital banking, consumer finance, payments, e-commerce, gaming, content platforms, and social networking.

• Translate TCRS capabilities, including device risk, account security, transaction risk control, payment risk control, credit risk control, rule engines, and model scoring, into clear business value that clients can understand.

2. Support the End-to-End Overseas Sales Process

• Support sales, business development, and channel teams in client requirement discovery, solution design, technical engagement, product demonstration, POC execution, and pricing support.

• Independently conduct product introductions, solution walkthroughs, technical Q&A, and value presentations to clients in both native language and English.

• Help identify clients’ real pain points, purchasing motivations, and decision-making processes, and drive opportunities from the requirement stage to POC, quotation, and contract signing.

3. Design Anti-Fraud and Business Security Solutions

• Analyse client risk issues and design solutions across scenarios such as registration, login, marketing, transactions, payments, and account security.

• Cover typical risk cases including fake registration, account theft, marketing abuse, promotion abuse, card-not-present fraud, chargebacks, account takeover, and organised fraud.

• Design localised risk control solutions by combining capabilities such as device risk, behavioural risk, IP risk, account risk, relationship networks, rules, and machine learning models.

4. Support Financial Risk Management Solutions

• Design pre-loan, in-loan, and post-loan risk management solutions for financial clients, including digital banks, consumer finance companies, cash loan providers, BNPL platforms, payment institutions, and e-wallets.

• Cover key scenarios such as identity verification, application fraud detection, credit assessment, credit approval, limit management, transaction monitoring, post-loan early warning, and collection segmentation.

• Support financial clients in POC test design, performance evaluation, strategy optimisation, and business value assessment.

5. Drive Product Requirement Closure

• Collect overseas client requirements related to anti-fraud, payment risk control, credit risk management, and compliance risk management, and translate them into product requirements and implementation roadmaps.

• Work closely with product, R&D, algorithm, data, delivery, and sales teams to convert client requirements into product capabilities.

• Consolidate project experience from key accounts and develop standardised industry solutions, case studies, POC templates, and sales enablement tools.

6. Sales Enablement and Market Insights

• Deliver product training, industry training, case study training, and competitor training to sales, business development, channel, and partner teams.

• Produce materials such as product introductions, industry solution decks, client case studies, FAQs, competitor analysis, and deployment documentation.

• Track overseas trends in risk control, anti-fraud, fintech, and compliance, and provide input to support the overseas GTM strategy of TCRS.

Who We Look For

• Bachelor’s degree or above;

• Minimum 5 years of experience in internet risk control, anti-fraud, business security, fintech risk management, payment risk control, credit risk management, or related fields.

• Excellent bilingual communication skills in native language and English, with the ability to conduct client communication, solution presentations, business discussions, document drafting, and cross-border team collaboration in English. Madarin Speaking skill is a Plus.

• Strong client-facing communication skills and business understanding, with the ability to independently conduct requirement discovery, solution articulation, and value presentation.

• Strong cross-functional collaboration capabilities, with the ability to coordinate product, R&D, algorithm, delivery, sales, and partner resources to drive complex projects to successful delivery.

title: PC/Console 项目数据分析师（Publishing Data Analyst）
description:
团队介绍
Level Infinite 是腾讯旗下国际游戏业务品牌，致力为全球玩家带来充满乐趣、原汁原味的游戏体验，让玩家随时随地进入游戏世界；并通过打造包容、互通、便捷的玩家社区，促进分享交流。

Level Infinite为合作工作室提供一系列支持及服务，助力其释放产品潜能。

Level Infinite发行产品包括《PUBG MOBILE》、《Goddess of Victory: NIKKE 》《Honor of King》等热门游戏，并与合作工作室联手推出了来自Fatshark的《战锤40K：暗潮》、Funcom的《沙丘：觉醒》、Inflexion Studios的《夜莺》在内多款产品。

想进一步了解Level Infinite，请访问www.levelinfinite.com，并在Twitter、Facebook、Instagram和Youtube上关注我们的官方账号。

岗位职责

1. 产品预估模型

• 构建并迭代发行预估模型：基于品类基准、愿望单、Beta 测试、UR 测试，输出保守/基准/乐观三档销量与收入预估

• 校准 Steam 愿望单→首周转化率、首月→首年系数等关键参数，建立内部 Benchmark 数据库

• 按平台（Steam/Xbox/PS/Epic）拆分预测，结合分成阶梯、区域定价、退款率建模

2. 竞品与品类分析

• 维护 PC/Console 核心品类竞品数据库：销量估算、DAU/MAU、定价、更新频率、评测情感

• 定期输出品类趋势报告：新品成功率、头部集中度、品类增长/衰退信号

3. P&L 建模与敏感度分析

• 构建多年度 P&L 模型（收入侧：本体/GaaS/DLC；成本侧：研发/营销/平台/运营）

• 计算 Break-Even 销量、回本周期、LTV/CAC 等投资决策指标

4. 玩家行为与运营分析

• 设计核心指标体系：获客（Wishlist/CTR）、活跃（DAU/MAU）、留存（D1/D7/D30）、付费（ARPU/转化率/LTV）

• Beta 测试数据分析：玩家进度、付费意愿信号，输出优化建议

• 上线后 Live Ops 数据支持：赛季效果分析、版本更新 lift 测算

5. 数据基建

• 推动竞品/平台/游戏内数据的自动化采集与 ETL 管线

• 搭建发行侧 BI 看板（Tableau/Power BI/Metabase），为团队提供自助查询能力

岗位要求

1、PC/主机经验，5 年以上数据分析经验，其中至少 2 年游戏行业数据分析（PC/Console 优先）；或 5 年以上数据分析经验 + 自身为 PC/Console 重度核心玩家（Steam/PSN/Xbox 游戏库 100+），深度理解玩家行为与游戏生态

2、英语作为工作语言，能流畅阅读英文行业报告（Newzoo/SteamDB/GameDiscoverCo），分析 Steam 英文评测文本情感，参与英文会议讨论；

3、数据分析/商业分析/数据科学岗位累计 5 年以上，有预测建模或预估模型的实际构建经验；

4、熟练掌握 SQL，能独立完成复杂查询与数据清洗

5、熟练使用 Python 或 R 进行数据建模与统计分析

6、熟练使用至少一种 BI 工具（Tableau / Power BI / Metabase / Looker Studio）

7、数据叙事能力：将分析结果转化为清晰的结构化报告与可视化呈现

8、了解 PC/Console 游戏生态：愿望单、商店页、评测机制、赛季运营

加分项

• Steam 数据源实操（SteamDB / GameSensor / VG Insights / GameDiscoverCo）

• Game Analytics / Firebase / PlayFab 等游戏分析工具使用经验

• 爬虫开发经验（Scrapy / API 接入）

• 游戏经济系统分析能力

• A/B 测试设计与分析经验

腾讯致力于提供平等就业机会

在腾讯，我们始终秉承平等就业机会的原则，致力于为每一位员工打造公平、包容的工作环境。我们坚信，多元的声音能够激发出无限的创新活力，推动我们为用户和社会提供更优质的服务。我们用心营造一个充满支持与激励的氛围，帮助每一位员工找到属于自己的舞台，以实现个人及共同的发展目标。

title: Global Communications Manager
description:
What the Role Entails
We are looking for a Global Communications Specialist to support the company’s global and regional communications efforts across artificial intelligence and related technologies.

The role will serve as a communications partner to business, product and technology teams. The successful candidate will develop a strong understanding of Tencent’s evolving AI strategy, Hunyuan models, applications, cloud capabilities, and broader industry trends, and communicate these complex and rapidly evolving developments in ways that are clear, accurate, and relevant for global audiences, including media, customers, users, partners and other stakeholders.

Working closely with the core Global Communications team, the role will contribute to the development of Tencent’s global and regional messaging and help lead communications initiatives that strengthen the thought leadership and reputation of Tencent Hy and the company’s broader application of AI and cloud technologies across different industries.

The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of international markets, together with the perspective and cultural sensitivity required to communicate Tencent’s technology and business approach effectively across different regions.

The individual should also be curious about emerging communications channels and be comfortable working across traditional media, social media, podcasts, video platforms and other digital formats.
1. Business and Product Communications

• Serve as a key communications contact for relevant business, product, engineering and research teams.

• Develop a strong understanding of Tencent’s evolving AI, large model and cloud strategies, technologies, products and applications.

• Identify communications opportunities arising from product developments, customer use cases, research, partnerships and industry trends.

• Study global AI developments and industry narratives to understand how the technology landscape and public conversation are evolving.

• Translate complex technical and business information into clear, accessible and compelling narratives for international audiences.

• Ensure that messaging related to AI, large models and cloud reflects the company’s business priorities, innovation, technological strengths and long-term positioning.

2. Thought Leadership and Reputation Building

• Develop and execute communications initiatives that strengthen Tencent’s thought leadership in cloud computing, enterprise AI, foundation models and emerging technologies

• Develop PR materials such as key messages, talking points, Q&As, briefing documents, executive presentations and background materials; as well as media pitches, press materials, briefing documents and interview preparation materials.

• Identify suitable industry topics, platforms and conversations where Tencent executives and technical experts can contribute meaningful perspectives.

• Work with Regional Communications team to adapt global narratives for different markets

3. Integrated Content and New Communications Channels

• Explore new ways to communicate Tencent’s cloud and AI stories

• Work closely with Tencent’s global social media team to develop content for international channels.

• Identify opportunities to repurpose technical, business and executive content across media, social and digital platforms.

• Support the development of editorial calendars, campaign concepts and multimedia content.

• Experiment with new storytelling approaches that make complex AI and cloud topics more engaging and accessible.

Who We Look For

Essential Qualifications and Experience

• Fluency in both Mandarin Chinese and English, with strong written and verbal communication skills in both languages.

• Relevant experience in corporate communications, technology communications, public relations, content strategy or a related field.

• Strong understanding of international media and communications practices.

• Ability to understand complex technology and business topics and communicate them clearly to non-technical audiences.

• Experience working with business leaders, product teams, engineers or technical experts.

• Strong project-management and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to coordinate across different business groups and functions.

• Sound judgement and sensitivity when communicating across different markets, cultures and regulatory environments.

• Ability to work effectively in a fast-moving environment and manage multiple priorities.

Preferred Qualifications

• Previous years of experience working for an AI, cloud, internet or enterprise technology company.

• Familiarity with foundation models, generative AI, enterprise AI, cloud infrastructure or related technologies.

• Existing relationships with international technology, business or trade media.

• Experience developing content for podcasts, video platforms, social media or other emerging communications channels.

• Experience working across both China and international markets.

Key Competencies

• Strategic communications thinking

• Strong editorial and storytelling ability

• Intellectual curiosity and willingness to learn

• Stakeholder influence and collaboration

• Creativity in identifying stories and communications channels

Measures of Success

• Stronger and more consistent global messaging for Tencent Cloud, Large Model and AI.

• High-quality global communications programs and content.

• Meaningful international media, social media and thought-leadership engagement.

• Improved understanding of Tencent’s cloud and AI strategy among customers, partners, media and other global stakeholders.

What the Role Entails

About WeChat

With over 1.3 billion users worldwide, WeChat is shaping the future of digital communication by connecting people, services, and businesses across the globe. The WeChat operations team offers a unique opportunity to redefine how users engage with mobile technology while gaining valuable insights into global user behavior and preferences. Based in Singapore, our team is responsible for managing and expanding WeChat’s core product offerings, including messaging and social networking, for users outside the Chinese mainland. Join us in making a meaningful impact by keeping millions of people connected through one of the world's most influential digital platforms.

About the Internship

WeChat’s internships provide paid, full-time opportunities lasting a minimum of 12 weeks. Interns will be mentored by senior members of the WeChat operations team and work hands-on in developing new projects and product features. By the end of the internship, participants will have gained a deep understanding of WeChat’s values, independently executed data-driven projects, and collaborated effectively across multiple departments, including product, engineering, and legal teams.

Why Join Us?

• Gain hands-on experience with large-scale data in a leading global tech company

• Work with cutting-edge technologies and experienced mentors in a dynamic environment

• Be part of an impact-driven team that shapes digital communication worldwide

Responsibilities

• Analyze large-scale datasets to identify business opportunities, detect patterns, and optimize product performance across the platform.

• Develop data dashboards and visualization tools to track key performance metrics and provide actionable product insights.

• Design and build scalable data pipelines to support analytics, operational decision-making, and platform security initiatives.

• Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders (product, engineering, operations, and security teams) to translate analytical findings into business strategies and product improvements.

• Leverage AI-powered tools and technologies (e.g., LLMs, AI copilots, data assistants) to enhance analysis efficiency, automate workflows, and improve decision accuracy while maintaining robust traditional data engineering and analytics practices.

• Explore and integrate AI-driven methodologies to optimize analytical processes, including automated data exploration, report generation, and intelligent insight discovery.

Who We Look For

Requirements

• Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field.

• Strong experience in data analytics and data engineering, including building data pipelines, statistical analysis, and data visualization.

• Proficiency in SQL and Python, with experience working with large-scale data platforms (e.g., Hive, Spark, or similar big data environments).

• Experience building data dashboards and reporting tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Superset, or similar platforms).

• Familiarity with AI-assisted data analysis tools, including prompt engineering, context engineering, and AI workflow integration.

• Experience with RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), AI agents, MCP frameworks, or similar AI infrastructure is a strong plus.

• Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to break down complex problems into structured analytical approaches.

• Excellent learning ability, curiosity for new technologies, and a strong sense of ownership and self-driven execution.

title: ゲームデザイナー｜Game Designer
description:
チーム紹介/About the Hiring Team
ライトスピード・ジャパンは、世界中のオーディエンス向けにオリジナルのAAA級アクションゲームタイトルの制作に特化しているゲーム開発スタジオです。著名なゲームディレクターとして知られる伊津野英昭（いつの ひであき）が率いる当スタジオは、東京と大阪の2つの拠点で活動しています。

柔軟で包括的な職場環境を提供し、ゲーム制作の限界を押し広げる才能と情熱にあふれるゲームクリエイターの参加を非常に歓迎しています。

LightSpeed Japan Studio is a game development studio dedicated to crafting original AAA action game titles for global audiences. Led by industry veteran Hideaki Itsuno, the studio operates across two locations in Tokyo and Osaka.

The studio offers a flexible and inclusive work environment and actively welcomes game creators who are full of talent and passion for pushing the boundaries of game development.

仕事内容/What the Role Entails

仕事内容

1.ゲームメカニクスの設計 ゲーム内での基本的なルール、システム、バトルメカニクスを企画し、プレイヤーが感じる楽しさと挑戦のバランスを取ります。

2.ステージおよびレベルデザイン 各ステージやミッションの構成を設計し、プレイヤーにとって適度な難易度とやりがいを提供します。敵の配置やギミック、報酬などの要素を組み合わせ、ステージを効果的に演出します。

3.UIデザインおよびゲームテキストの作成 UIの遷移や仕様をデザイン、ゲーム内テキストやセリフなどを作成します。

4.プレイテストとフィードバック分析 アクションゲームにおいて重要な戦闘システムをデザインし、キャラクターのスキルやコンボ、AIの動作パターンなど、プレイヤーが感じる戦略性と達成感を強化します。

5.他部門との調整と協力 プログラマー、アーティスト、音響デザイナーなど他のチームメンバーと連携し、全体のゲーム体験が一貫性を持つよう調整します。

Job Description

1. Game Mechanics Design Plan and design the fundamental rules, systems, and battle mechanics within the game, balancing the enjoyment and challenge felt by the player.

2. Stage and Level Design Design the structure of each stage and mission, providing an appropriate level of difficulty and engagement for the player. Combine elements such as enemy placements, mechanics, and rewards to create effective stages.

3. UI Design and Game Text Creation Design UI transitions and specifications, and create in-game text and dialogue.

4. Playtesting and Feedback Analysis Design critical combat systems for action games, enhancing player strategy and a sense of achievement through character skills, combos, and AI behavior patterns.

5. Coordination and Collaboration with Other Departments Work closely with programmers, artists, sound designers, and other team members to ensure a consistent overall game experience.

応募資格/Who We Look For

応募資格

1.AAAタイトルでのゲームデザイン経験（優遇）

2.アクションゲームにおけるメカニクス設計やレベルデザインの知識（優遇）

3.プレイヤー視点で考えられる柔軟な発想力と論理的思考力

4.プレイテストからのフィードバックを活かした調整・改善ができるスキル

5.他部門との円滑なコミュニケーション能力

Requirements

1. Experience in game design for AAA titles (preferred)

2. Knowledge in mechanics design and level design for action games (preferred)

3. Flexible creativity and logical thinking from a player's perspective

4. Skills in making adjustments and improvements based on feedback from playtests

5. Strong communication skills for smooth collaboration with other departments

description:
Business Unit
Cloud & Smart Industries Group (CSIG) is responsible for promoting the company's cloud and industry Internet strategy. CSIG explores the interactions between users and industries to create innovative solutions for smart industries via technological advancements such as cloud, AI, and network security. While driving the digitalization of retail, medical, education, transportation and other industries, CSIG helps companies serve users in smarter ways, building a new ecosystem of intelligent industries that connect users and businesses.

What the Role Entails
Tencent Cloud is rapidly expanding its cloud solutions across global markets, and we're looking for passionate and curious individuals to join our Solutions Architecture Internship Program. As a Solution Architecture Intern, you'll gain hands-on experience working alongside experienced cloud architects to design, document, and present technical solutions that address real-world client challenges. Whether supporting presales engagements, contributing to product enablement, or researching architecture patterns across industries, this internship will equip you with practical exposure to cloud technologies and cross-functional collaboration. If you're eager to grow your career in cloud computing and solution design, this is your chance to step into the future of enterprise technology.

Responsibilities

• Assist solution architects in understanding client use cases and mapping them to Tencent Cloud’s products and services.

• Support the preparation of solution proposals, technical documentation, and client presentations across verticals.

• Participate in technical enablement programs, including cloud certification training materials and product workshops.

• Research industry-specific architecture patterns and provide recommendations to optimize cloud adoption.

• Assist in cross-team collaboration and feedback loops between presales, product, and engineering teams.

• Contribute to internal knowledge bases and best practices documentation for regional and global use.

Who We Look For

• Currently pursuing Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Computer Science or related fields, graduating in 2026. Candidates without relevant majors but with a great passion in technology are encouraged to apply.

• Open to commit to a minimum 3 months full time internship.

• Previous experience in B2B solution architecture internships would be highly advantageous, particularly in IaaS or PaaS or SaaS, but not mandatory.

• Demonstrate creativity, strong logical thinking, and exceptional problem-solving abilities, coupled with excellent communication skills.

• Passionate about cloud technologies and product management, with a keen interest in researching various cloud products and a focus on enhancing user experience.

• Excellent written and spoken English is required. Proficiency in Chinese Mandarin is required as approximately 50% of the role involves collaborating with China headquarters on business discussions, meetings, and documentation.

Equal Employment Opportunity at Tencent

As an equal opportunity employer, we firmly believe that diverse voices fuel our innovation and allow us to better serve our users and the community. We foster an environment where every employee of Tencent feels supported and inspired to achieve individual and common goals.

title: Client Success Manager – EMEA
description:
Business Unit
Corporate Development Group (CDG) as the platform for the company's new business incubation and new business exploration, CDG is responsible for promoting development and innovation for important areas such as financial technology and advertising, as well as marketing services, including payment and financial applications. As a professional support platform, CDG also supports the company and various business groups in strategic planning, investments and mergers, investor relations and corporate global communications, marketing and public relations, and more.

What the Role Entails

Core Objective:

Drive commercialization and growth for Tencent’s overseas performance advertising business across the EMEA region. Own both demand-side advertiser growth and supply-side publisher monetization, accelerating revenue growth, improving ecosystem efficiency, and building scalable commercialization solutions that drive long-term business success.

Key Responsibilities:

Drive Regional Commercialization Strategy

•
Develop and execute commercialization strategies across EMEA to unlock new growth opportunities.

•
Drive advertiser acquisition and spend growth while optimizing publisher monetization, delivering measurable improvements in revenue, platform scale, and operational efficiency.

Build Scalable Commercial Solutions

•
Partner with Product, Engineering, and Operations teams to translate advertiser and publisher insights into scalable platform capabilities and operational improvements.

•
Develop industry best practices and commercialization solutions that can be replicated across markets and verticals.

Partner with Sales to Accelerate Growth

•
Work closely with regional Sales teams to identify high-value opportunities, support solution design, and drive successful deal execution.

•
Improve customer acquisition, conversion efficiency, and overall business expansion across both advertisers and publishers.

Drive Customer Success & Business Growth

•
Own the end-to-end success of advertisers and publishers across EMEA.

•
Drive product adoption, campaign optimization, and monetization performance to maximize customer value, long-term retention, and sustainable revenue growth.

Who We Look For

Experience

•
5+ years of experience in performance advertising, ad tech, commercialization, client solutions, business strategy, or growth operations.

•
Hands-on experience with advertising platforms, DSPs, SSPs, ad networks, mobile advertising, or performance marketing is highly preferred.

Industry Knowledge

•
Strong understanding of the digital advertising ecosystem across both demand-side advertising and supply-side monetization.

•
Familiar with campaign optimization, ROAS/ROI measurement, inventory monetization, fill rate, eCPM, and performance-driven advertising models.

Skills

•
Strong analytical mindset with the ability to turn data into actionable business insights.

•
Excellent problem-solving, stakeholder management, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

•
Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and execute effectively in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment.

Others

•
Professional proficiency in both English and Mandarin is required to collaborate effectively with HQ in China.

•
Additional language skills, including French, German, Spanish, or Arabic, are a strong plus.

•
Comfortable working across multiple time zones and managing regional travel as needed. Strong adaptability to ambiguity and changing priorities. Entrepreneurial mindset with strong bias for action, impact, and scalability.

•
Entrepreneurial, proactive, and results-oriented with a strong sense of ownership.

•
Comfortable working across multiple time zones and managing regional travel as required.

•
Passionate about driving scalable business growth and delivering measurable commercial impact.

Equal Employment Opportunity at Tencent

As an equal opportunity employer, we firmly believe that diverse voices fuel our innovation and allow us to better serve our users and the community. We foster an environment where every employee of Tencent feels supported and inspired to achieve individual and common goals.

title: Senior Multimedia Design Manager
description:
团队介绍
Level Infinite 是腾讯旗下国际游戏业务品牌，致力为全球玩家带来充满乐趣、原汁原味的游戏体验，让玩家随时随地进入游戏世界；并通过打造包容、互通、便捷的玩家社区，促进分享交流。

Level Infinite为合作工作室提供一系列支持及服务，助力其释放产品潜能。

Level Infinite发行产品包括《PUBG MOBILE》、《Goddess of Victory: NIKKE 》《Honor of King》等热门游戏，并与合作工作室联手推出了来自Fatshark的《战锤40K：暗潮》、Funcom的《沙丘：觉醒》、Inflexion Studios的《夜莺》在内多款产品。

想进一步了解Level Infinite，请访问www.levelinfinite.com，并在Twitter、Facebook、Instagram和Youtube上关注我们的官方账号。

岗位职责

• 流程与标准建设梳理并优化素材生产管线，建立可复用的质量标准、评审机制与协作流程，持续提升团队效率与交付一致性。

岗位要求

• 4年以上游戏行业美术项目管理或创意项目管理经验

• 有3A端游/手游项目经验，熟悉不同平台素材规格与制作流程

• 英语可作为工作语言，能独立主持英文会议、撰写英文文档

• 熟悉3D，视频和平面设计主流设计工具的基本能力边界，能对素材质量做出专业判断

• 强跨部门沟通与推动力，能在多线程、多时区协作中保持节奏

• 结果导向，对素材质量和交付时效有明确标准

• 能在项目需求模糊时主动拉齐信息、推动共识，而非被动等待

加分项

• 有海外留学或海外工作经历

• 有对接外部供应商/freelancer的管理经验

• 有商务拓展或客户管理经验

• 了解AI设计工具以及AI Agent在生产管线中的应用

• 热爱游戏

title: Senior Manager, Business Strategy & Operations
description:
团队介绍
腾讯游戏商务部的主旨是建立腾讯与全球优质厂商的桥梁，服务与全球100+投资伙伴和重要厂商。持续扩大腾讯在全球互联网生态和游戏行业的影响力，利用敏锐的嗅觉捕捉高潜力商业合作机会，并帮助投资伙伴持续的成长。深耕亚太、欧美和新兴市场，与日本、韩国、美国、英国、法国、芬兰、德国等成熟市场和东南亚、中东、土耳其等新区域的伙伴建立了深度的战略合作关系，实现商业上的共赢。

商务部期待全球的优秀人才一同加入，通过全球的优质人才网络巩固和扩大腾讯与全球合作伙伴的合作关系，并为市场孵化更多优质的游戏产品。

岗位职责
The role will help the department navigate a highly complex portfolio spanning global investment, post-investment management, strategic partnerships and commercial collaboration. The successful candidate should be able to see the full picture, identify the issues that truly matter, and translate complexity into clear insights that senior management can act on and teams can execute against.
This is not a traditional PMO or reporting role. We are looking for someone with strong business judgment, exceptional structuring capabilities and a low-ego, high-ownership mindset—someone who proactively identifies gaps, steps in where needed and drives critical work through to completion.
The candidate must also be both an active gamer and a hands-on AI practitioner, with genuine passion for games and AI.
1. Strategic Framing and Decision Support

Develop and continuously refine the strategic framework for Tencent Games’ global investment, post-investment management, strategic partnerships and commercial collaboration.

Work closely with the Head of Global BD, the leadership team and key stakeholders to identify strategic priorities, define key initiatives and translate strategic direction into actionable business plans.

Synthesize complex and fragmented business information into clear, structured and decision-ready insights that senior management can quickly understand and act on.

Identify emerging opportunities, critical issues and key trade-offs early, and provide clear recommendations rather than simply reporting information.

Connect external market developments with Tencent Games’ internal priorities to support better strategic judgment.

2. Department Business Management and Operating System

Build and operate the department’s annual and quarterly planning, business review and priority-management mechanisms.

Maintain a comprehensive view across investments, partnerships, regions, Cells and strategic initiatives, ensuring that the most important matters receive appropriate management attention.

Work with Cell owners, regional teams and cross-functional partners to set, break down and review business objectives and performance metrics.

Establish clear ownership, milestones, decision points and escalation mechanisms for key initiatives.

Reduce reliance on manual tracking and individual information bottlenecks by building scalable and reusable operating mechanisms.

3. Business Performance Review and Analysis

Conduct monthly and quarterly reviews of business performance, strategic initiatives and organizational priorities.

Identify key progress, risks, gaps and dependencies, and translate them into clear management implications and recommended actions.

Develop dashboards, trackers and review materials that help management understand not only what happened, but also why it matters and what decisions are required.

Ensure important decisions, actions and lessons are captured and followed through.

4. Critical Initiative Ownership

Own and drive selected strategic initiatives from initial framing through execution.

Proactively identify execution gaps and step into uncovered areas to keep critical work moving.

Bring together the necessary business, investment, finance, legal, HR and other functional perspectives to turn strategic intent into concrete outcomes.

Build repeatable frameworks and processes instead of managing issues case by case.

Support the department in handling complex, high-priority or time-sensitive topics that require cross-business judgment and strong execution.

5. Executive Communication and Organizational Translation

Prepare decision papers, strategic reviews and executive presentations for the Head of Global BD and senior management.

Translate complex business discussions into language that is:

clear enough for senior executives to make decisions;

practical enough for teams to understand and execute.

Ensure strategic priorities, management decisions and key messages are communicated consistently across an international organization.

Serve as a trusted sparring partner who can challenge assumptions constructively while maintaining strong relationships with senior executives and stakeholders.

6. Industry Insight and Organizational Intelligence

Stay current on global games industry trends, investment activity, competitive dynamics, emerging business models and technology developments.

Develop a strong understanding of Tencent Games’ internal businesses, key stakeholders, decision-making processes and organizational context.

Build broad knowledge across investment, post-investment management, strategic partnerships, commercial collaboration and regional BD.

Apply sound interpersonal judgment and organizational sensitivity when handling complex stakeholder topics.

7. AI-Enabled Business Operations

Actively explore and apply AI tools to improve research, analysis, knowledge management, workflow automation, document creation and decision support.

Identify opportunities to redesign existing business-management workflows with AI, rather than simply using AI to accelerate isolated tasks.

Turn recurring management work, effective prompts, workflows and institutional knowledge into reusable team capabilities.

Contribute to the development of the department’s AI Infra, knowledge base and organizational memory.

Share effective AI practices and help raise AI fluency across the broader BD team.

岗位要求

Professional Experience

3+ years of relevant professional experience in strategy consulting, corporate strategy and operations, Chief of Staff roles, investment banking, investment, or business management within gaming or technology companies.

Experience in the games industry, global business development, investment, post-investment management or strategic partnerships is strongly preferred.

Demonstrated experience working with senior executives and driving cross-functional strategic initiatives.

Experience operating in a complex, international and multicultural organization is preferred.

Business and Strategic Capabilities

Exceptional structuring and synthesis skills, with the ability to understand complex businesses, identify the key issue and translate complexity into clear frameworks and decisions.

Strong strategic judgment, analytical capability and problem-solving skills.

Able to balance attention to detail with a clear view of overall business priorities.

Strong understanding of—or demonstrated ability to quickly learn—investment, commercial partnerships, business operations and organizational management.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both Chinese and English.

Gaming Passion，must be a passionate and active gamer.

Demonstrate strong knowledge of player experiences, major game genres, leading products, game companies and global industry dynamics.

Able to translate product experience and player insight into independent business and strategic judgment.

Candidates should be prepared to discuss the games they actively play, their understanding of different genres and business models, and their views on major industry trends.

AI Passion and Hands-On Experience,must have a genuine passion for AI and be an active, hands-on user of AI tools in daily work.

Demonstrate real experience using AI for research, analysis, knowledge management, workflow automation, content creation or decision support.

Able to provide concrete examples of how AI has improved the quality, speed or scope of their work.

Curious about emerging AI products and willing to continuously learn, experiment and share reusable practices.

Coding, agent-building or workflow-automation experience is a plus, but not required.

Leadership and Working Style

Low ego and high ownership—focused on outcomes rather than visibility or personal credit.

Highly proactive and self-driven; identifies gaps and takes action before being asked.

Comfortable stepping into ambiguous or uncovered areas and taking work through to completion.

Strong interpersonal judgment and organizational sensitivity, with the ability to work effectively across different functions, seniority levels and cultural backgrounds.

Able to operate effectively behind the scenes while having the confidence to challenge and influence senior stakeholders.

Entrepreneurial, resilient and results-oriented, with a demonstrated track record of driving meaningful outcomes

title: Lead Game Development Expert, AI-Asset & Animation Production
description:
About the Hiring Team
Tencent Overseas IT has the mission to empower Tencent’s rapid global growth with future ready, global IT platforms, applications and services. We are chartered to lead the Overseas IT strategy, architecture, roadmap and execution. Satisfying our internal/external customers and becoming a world class global IT team are our top aspirations.

What the Role Entails
We are looking for a lead game development expert with deep AAA production experience to strengthen co-development and technical partnership between Tencent and its overseas investment and partner studios.
The successful candidate will bring a strong technical art and animation background, with a particular focus on asset production and animation workflows. Instead of covering the full breadth of art disciplines, this role concentrates on AI-enabled asset creation, asset performance optimisation, asset visual fidelity and on the animation side skeleton design, rigging and physics-based animation.

•
Participate in co-development projects between Tencent and its overseas investment and partner studios, providing senior expertise in AI-enabled asset production, asset performance optimisation, asset visual quality, skeleton design, rigging and physics-based animation.

•
Make AI-driven asset and animation improvement a central pillar of technical collaboration. Identify concrete opportunities across the full asset lifecycle (modelling, texturing, materials, LODs, performance profiling) and animation disciplines (skeleton generation, skinning, control rigs, cloth, hair, rigid-body dynamics and ragdoll setups).

•
Lead or contribute to proof-of-concept projects that integrate AI tools with existing asset authoring tools, animation rigging environments, physics engines, and Unreal Engine or equivalent game engines.

•
Evaluate the suitability, feasibility and expected value of AI solutions for asset and animation challenges. Define measurable metrics covering asset creation time, memory/performance budgets, visual fidelity, rigging speed, animation quality, physics stability and overall pipeline scalability.

•
Work closely with Art Directors, Technical Artists, Animators, Riggers, Character Artists, Environment Artists, Engineers, Producers and AI specialists to translate creative and production requirements into practical, measurable solutions focused on assets and animation.

•
Drive the transition of successful AI experiments into daily production workflows. Collect user feedback, refine asset and animation pipelines, and document repeatable implementation approaches for asset generation, optimisation, rigging automation and physics setup.

•
Establish human-review and quality-control mechanisms for AI-assisted asset and animation workflows, ensuring visual consistency, animation fidelity, physical plausibility, performance targets and intellectual property/data security are respected.

•
Lead technical investigations and solution designs for complex asset production challenges (e.g., automated LOD generation, material and texture optimisation, shader performance) and animation challenges (e.g., auto-rigging, physics-aware motion, real-time cloth simulation).

•
Bridge overseas studio requirements with Tencent’s internal AI capabilities, asset platforms, animation technology stacks and subject-matter experts.

•
Document reusable AI use cases, asset pipeline standards, rigging and physics best practices, performance guidelines and evaluation methods. Share knowledge through workshops, technical reviews and project retrospectives.

•
Monitor trends in generative AI, neural rendering, procedural content generation, machine learning for deformation and physics, digital humans and real-time graphics, assessing their practical value for AAA asset and animation production.

Who We Look For

•
Bachelor’s degree or above in Computer Graphics, Digital Media, Game Development, Art and Design, Animation, Software Engineering or a related discipline. Equivalent professional experience will also be considered.

•
At least 8 years of professional experience in technical art, animation technology or a closely related discipline, with significant exposure to AAA asset and animation pipelines.

•
Experience operating as a Senior Technical Artist, Lead Technical Artist, Technical Art Director, Animation Pipeline Lead, Rigging Lead or equivalent senior role with a clear focus on assets and/or animation.

•
Proven development experience on a recognised AAA game project, including at least one shipped AAA title where you were directly responsible for asset optimisation, rigging, or physics-animation workflows.

•
Strong understanding of the complete AAA asset and animation lifecycle, from initial modelling and rigging, through version control and validation, to engine integration, performance profiling and runtime optimisation.

•
Strong interest in generative AI, machine learning and intelligent automation, especially as applied to asset generation, asset optimisation, auto-rigging, motion synthesis, deformation prediction and physics simulation.

•
Ability to identify high-value AI opportunities rooted in real asset and animation production challenges and progress them through proof-of-concept, workflow design, tool integration and production adoption.

•
Strong experience with Unreal Engine or another major game engine, including real-time rendering, asset management, animation blueprints, physics assets and cross-platform performance constraints.

•
Proficiency in Blender or Maya; working knowledge of Houdini is a plus.

•
Experience with tools development or workflow automation using Python, C++, Blueprint or equivalent, particularly for asset processing, rigging automation or physics pipeline tools.

•
Strong problem-solving, solution design and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to balance asset quality, animation expressiveness, engineering feasibility and production efficiency.

•
Excellent English communication skills, able to lead technical discussions, conduct solution reviews, prepare documentation and collaborate effectively in an international environment.

•
Willingness to work across regions and time zones and to travel to partner studios in Europe or other locations when required.

Deep expertise in several of the following areas:

•
​​(1) AAA asset production pipelines (characters, environments, props) with a strong emphasis on performance optimisation, memory budgets, LOD strategies and visual consistency.

•
(2) Asset visual quality and efficiency: material authoring, texture optimisation, shading models, draw call management and cross-platform asset validation.

•
(3) Skeleton design and character/creature rigging: hierarchical structures, joint placement, modular rig systems, and auto-rigging methods.

•
(4) Skinning and deformation: linear blend skinning, dual quaternion skinning, corrective blendshapes, muscle systems and deformation quality control.

•
(5) Physics-based animation: cloth, hair, rigid-body dynamics, ragdoll setups, secondary motion, and real-time physics constraints in engine.

想进一步了解Level Infinite，请访问www.levelinfinite.com，并在Twitter、Facebook、Instagram和Youtube上关注我们的官方账号。

岗位职责

1、基础运营体系建设与管理

• 财务与预算管理： 统筹部门年度预算编制，协同各团队按季度完成Review，输出高质量的经营分析报告。管理人力投入及日常财务流程，持续优化各业务线的成本效率。

• BSC 管理： 协助建立并维护部门BSC，按季度汇总财务与非财务指标并跟踪目标完成度。

• OKR 管理： 主导部门级 OKR 的制定、对齐与季度复盘，确保与 IEGG 整体战略方向高度一致。协助各业务线拆解 OKR 并跟踪进度，主动识别风险并推动问题解决。

2、业务优化与团队支持

• 深入理解本地化、用户研究、创意设计、用户获取（UA）等各业务线的运作模式与核心痛点。

• 主动发现业务流程瓶颈与效率提升机会，推动跨团队协作机制的优化与落地。

• 协助各业务团队负责人进行业务数据分析与复盘，为关键业务决策提供有力输入。

• 在重大跨团队项目中担任业务合作伙伴（BP）角色，确保项目按时按质交付。

3、OGS 业务合作伙伴 — 研发与发行流程能力承接

• 作为 OGS 的 BP，在游戏研发与发行的各阶段主动识别介入节点，推动 Pipeline 产品与 OGS 能力的精准匹配，变被动响应为主动赋能。

• 研发阶段： 主动对接二方工作室，明确 OGS 可提供的全方位支持。维护 Pipeline 产品的全景视图，确保各产品阶段的需求与 OGS 能力库实现有效对齐。

• 发行阶段： 前置协调内外部资源，确保本地化、用户研究、创意设计、UA 等各环节的支持工作及时、到位。

岗位要求

1、经验背景： 5年以上游戏行业战略运营或全球发行相关工作经验，对预算管理、成本分析与经营分析有扎实的理解和实践。

2、数据与 AI 能力： 具备极强的结构化思维能力，精通各类数据分析与可视化工具。能够熟练运用 AI 工具提升工作效率，并拥有将 AI 深度融入日常工作流的成熟方法论与实践经验。

3、沟通与推动力： 中英文流利，具备出色的跨团队、跨文化协调能力。能够在多方利益诉求中有效推动共识达成，并拿到最终结果。

4、项目管理： 具备强大的多线程并行推进能力，自驱力强，能在高压环境下保持清晰的思路与稳定的交付质量。
加分项：

description:
团队介绍
Level Infinite 是腾讯旗下国际游戏业务品牌，致力为全球玩家带来充满乐趣、原汁原味的游戏体验，让玩家随时随地进入游戏世界；并通过打造包容、互通、便捷的玩家社区，促进分享交流。

Level Infinite发行产品包括《PUBG MOBILE》、《Goddess of Victory: NIKKE 》《Honor of King》等热门游戏，并与合作工作室联手推出了来自Fatshark的《战锤40K：暗潮》、Funcom的《沙丘：觉醒》、Inflexion Studios的《夜莺》在内多款产品。

想进一步了解Level Infinite，请访问www.levelinfinite.com，并在Twitter、Facebook、Instagram和Youtube上关注我们的官方账号。

岗位职责
在K8，我们与Grinding Gear Games紧密合作，共同应对游戏开发中的各类挑战。我们秉持“low ego, high standards”的团队文化，致力于打造一个张弛有度的工作环境。在这里，你既能保持松弛感以专注思考，又能被团队自驱向上的热忱与对游戏的热爱所感染，与大家合力打造全球顶级的PC及主机端ARPG游戏。
1. 负责游戏性能及资源体量优化，围绕角色、场景、材质和特效等内容开展贴图规格、包体大小及运行时性能治理，在保障画面品质 的前提下降低资源开销；

2. 基于项目自研引擎编写和维护 HLSL Shader，参与材质节点、光照、阴影、后处理、粒子、体积效果等渲染能力建设；

3. 与图形开发、美术及工具团队紧密协作，将艺术需求转化为稳定、可扩展且兼顾性能的实时渲染方案；

4. 参与材质编辑、粒子与特效编辑、场景编辑及资源检查等美术工具和工作流的设计、验证与优化；

5. 建立并维护模型、材质、贴图、特效等美术资源的制作规范和性能预算，定位并解决 GPU 开销、Shader 变体、贴图显存及资源复杂度等问题；

6. 为美术团队提供日常技术支持，推动问题定位、效果调试和跨平台适配，提升内容生产效率与最终画面一致性；

7. 编写并维护技术文档、制作规范和最佳实践，组织工具培训及技术分享，提升团队整体技术能力。

岗位要求

1. 热爱 PC 游戏，关注用户体验，责任心强，对游戏研发有浓厚兴趣。

2. 具备 1 年及以上游戏行业技术美术或相关岗位经验，熟悉游戏美术资源从制作、导入、编译到运行时呈现的完整流程；

3. 具备良好的审美能力，理解色彩、构图、物理光照及 PBR 材质理论，能够分析并改善暗黑写实风格下的画面表现；

4. 具备扎实的计算机图形学和数学基础，理解线性代数、坐标变换、光照模型、纹理采样及常见实时渲染算法；

5. 熟悉现代实时渲染管线，理解材质、光照、阴影、透明、后处理、GPU 粒子等模块的基本原理；

6. 熟练掌握 HLSL、GLSL 或其他至少一种 Shader 编程语言，能够编写结构清晰、性能合理且易于维护的 Shader；

7. 拥抱AI技术，愿意主动学习并合理使用 AI 工具提升开发效率、代码质量和问题解决效率。

腾讯致力于提供平等就业机会

在腾讯，我们始终秉承平等就业机会的原则，致力于为每一位员工打造公平、包容的工作环境。我们坚信，多元的声音能够激发出无限的创新活力，推动我们为用户和社会提供更优质的服务。我们用心营造一个充满支持与激励的氛围，帮助每一位员工找到属于自己的舞台，以实现个人及共同的发展目标。

1.  ゲーム内のエリア、背景、オブジェクトの3Dモデリングおよびテクスチャ作成を行い、リアルな質感とディテールを実現。

2.  コンセプトアートを元に、ゲーム内ビジュアルスタイルに合わせた精緻な背景デザインを制作。

3.  シェーダーやマテリアルの設定を行い、ゲーム内の質感や光沢、反射などを再現。

4.  リアルタイムレンダリングやパフォーマンスの最適化を行い、ゲームプレイのクオリティを維持。

5.  アートディレクターやレベルデザイナーと連携し、ゲームプレイやストーリーと調和した背景の実現。

• Tencent チームとスタジオリーダーシップの間で、パブリッシング関連の明確なコミュニケーションを促進する。

市場 & パフォーマンス評価

リーダーシップ & メンタリング

• パブリッシング担当者を指導し、スタジオおよび Tencent のパブリッシング水準の向上に貢献する。

2. Proficient in conditional generation models and multi-player/multi-channel control technologies; familiar with the principles of diffusion models.
3. Project experience in camera control, trajectory control, or posture control.
4. Understanding of game engine input/output logic and frame synchronization mechanisms.
5. Proficient in Python/PyTorch, with publications in controllable video generation or conditional generation.
6. Experience in Game AI or game development is preferred.

title: World Model Research Intern
description:
About the Hiring Team
Level Infinite is Tencent’s global gaming brand. It is a global game publisher offering a comprehensive network of services for games, development teams, and studios around the world.

We are dedicated to delivering engaging and original gaming experiences to a worldwide audience, whenever and wherever they choose to play while building a community that fosters inclusivity, connection, and accessibility. What the Role Entails

Focus on cutting-edge algorithm research and development for World Models and Video Diffusion Models, exploring key issues such as video generation and video interaction. As a Generative AI Researcher (Intern), you will participate in one or more of the following tasks:

• Data Processing: Assist with the cleaning, filtering, annotation, and preprocessing pipelines for large-scale video/image data to build high-quality training datasets.

• Model Training: Help build highly efficient training frameworks for diffusion models, optimize training workflows, and take responsibility for managing, monitoring, and fine-tuning model training tasks.

• Technical Innovation: Deeply participate in technical project discussions, proactively propose innovative ideas or improvement plans, and actively drive the practical application and integration of research findings into game video generation and virtual world construction scenarios.

• Frontier Exploration: Collaborate closely with senior researchers to explore cutting-edge directions in the fields of digital content generation and interactive agents.

Who We Look For

• Enrolled as a PhD or Master’s student in Computer Vision, Computer Graphics, Machine Learning, or a related field, familiarity with generative models.

• Strong background in deep learning with practical experience in image or video data processing. Capable of independently handling complex data cleaning tasks and constructing robust data pipelines.

• Strong interest in applying generative AI to interactive entertainment and virtual world building.

• Good communication and collaboration skills.

• Model Expertise: Familiarity with mainstream video generation models; hands-on experience in training or fine-tuning these models is highly preferred.

• Academic Record: Experience publishing relevant research in top-tier AI and computer vision conferences or journals (e.g., CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, ICLR, ICML, NeurIPS) is a strong plus.

title: Senior Researcher, Multi-Modality
description:
Business Unit
LIGHTSPEED STUDIOS is made up of passionate players who advance the art & science of game development through great stories, great gameplay, and advanced technology. We are focused on bringing next generation experiences to gamers who want to enjoy them anywhere, anytime, across multiple genres and devices.

About the Hiring Team
Lightspeed Tech Center is a R&D department under Lightspeed Studios which develop PUBG Mobile and other high-quality games. Our Tech Center leads the research, exploration, and discovery of innovative technologies and provides technical services for all games during all phases of life cycle, including engine, audio, QA, AI, next generation game, technical cooperation, etc.

What the Role Entails
We're looking for a Senior Researcher in multi-modality to help shape the next generation of multimodal foundation models and agentic AI within gaming scenarios. This role focuses on AI research and applications for in-game contexts — abstracting research problems from real game business scenarios, solving them, and deploying solutions that serve a wide range of gaming use cases. You'll work on multimodal understanding, post-training, and agent research, driving breakthroughs that advance both the scientific frontier and Tencent's game products at scale.

• Pioneer new research directions in multimodal understanding, post-training, reasoning, grounding, and agent planning, grounded in real gaming scenarios.

• Abstract research problems from game business scenarios, solve them, and land solutions that serve diverse in-game applications.

• Advance the understanding capabilities of multimodal large models (VLMs/MLLMs) across images, video, text, and audio.

• Lead post-training methodologies — SFT, RLHF/RLAIF, reward modeling, and preference alignment — to improve model capability and reliability.

• Design and execute experiments end-to-end: from data and benchmarking, to training, evaluation, and iteration.

• Collaborate with engineers to bring research prototypes into production and deploy them across game scenarios at scale.

• Publish at top-tier conferences and contribute to the broader research community.

Who We Look For

• PhD in Computer Science, ML, or a related field, or equivalent research experience.

• Expertise in one or more of: multimodal understanding and vision-language reasoning; pre-/post-training of LLMs/VLMs; reinforcement learning and LLM-based agents; representation learning.

• Ability to abstract research problems from real business (ideally gaming) scenarios and drive them to deployment.

• Consistent first-author publications at leading venues (NeurIPS, ICML, CVPR, ACL, etc.).

• Strong implementation skills in modern ML frameworks (PyTorch, JAX, etc.).

• Proven ability to run complex experiments, analyze results, and iterate quickly.

• Passion for high-impact research with real-world applications.
