title: 腾讯云日本销售经理｜テンセントクラウドセールスマネージャー（日本）
description:
部署紹介/Business Unit

仕事内容/What the Role Entails

工作内容：

1、负责腾讯云日本市场的业务拓展与销售达成，统筹渠道生态与直销双线推进，完成年度销售业绩目标；

2、渠道线：围绕核心渠道伙伴（含大型系统集成商/SI，如NTT DATA、CTC、TIS等），对齐战略方向及销售目标，制定渠道增长计划，推动伙伴赋能、培训认证、激励政策及商机转化落地；

3、直销线：独立负责日本市场头部客户（含大型企业、互联网公司及政企客户）的开拓与攻坚，主导全销售周期——从客户识别、需求洞察、方案设计到商务谈判与签约落地；

4、建立并维护与重点渠道伙伴及直销客户的长期合作关系，构建稳定的客户沟通及经营复盘机制，持续深耕客户价值，推动增购与交叉销售；

5、制定日本区域的"作战地图"，系统性拓展新合作伙伴及直销目标客户，管理完整的销售Pipeline，持续推动新商机的挖掘与转化；

6、整合公司内部资源（产品、解决方案、售前、交付等），推动解决渠道伙伴及直销客户在销售转化中的关键问题，持续优化销售流程与客户体验；

7、跟踪日本云计算市场动态及竞对策略，输出市场洞察，为业务决策及产品本地化提供一线输入。

仕事内容

1.テンセントクラウド日本におけるビジネス開発および売上目標を達成するため、チャネルエコシステムとダイレクトセールスの両輪を統括的に推進し、年度売上目標を完遂する。

2.チャネル：NTT DATA、CTC、TISなどの大手システムインテグレーター（SI）を含む中核パートナーを中心に、戦略方向性および売上目標をすり合わせ、チャネル成長計画を策定。パートナーの育成（イネブルメント）、研修・認定、インセンティブ政策、商談転換の着地を推進する。

3.ダイレクトセールス：日本市場の大手顧客（大手企業、インターネット企業、官公庁・企業顧客を含む）の開拓・深耕を単独で担当。顧客の特定、ニーズ把握、提案設計から商談交渉、契約着地まで、セールス全工程をリードする。

4.キーチャネルパートナーおよびダイレクトセールス顧客との長期的な協力関係を構築・維持し、安定した顧客コミュニケーションおよび運営振返りの仕組みを構築。継続的に顧客価値を深耕し、増枠購入およびクロスセルの推進を図る。

5.日本地域の「作戦マップ」を策定し、体系的に新規パートナーおよびダイレクトセールス目標顧客を拡大。完全なセールスパイプラインを管理し、新規商談の発掘と転換を継続的に推進する。

6.社内リソース（製品、ソリューション、プリセールス、デリバリー等）を統合し、チャネルパートナーおよびダイレクトセールス顧客がセールス転換において直面する肝要課題の解決を推進し、セールスプロセスおよび顧客体験を継続的に最適化する。

7.日本クラウドコンピューティング市場の動向および競合戦略を追跡し、市場インサイトをアウトプット。ビジネス意思決定および製品のローカライゼーションに現場のインプットを提供する。

応募資格/Who We Look For

能力要求

1、本科及以上学历，5年以上云计算或ICT行业销售经验，同时具备渠道拓展与直销/大客户销售实战经验；

2、熟悉日本云计算市场及商业生态，具备与大型系统集成商（SI）合作经验（如NTT DATA、CTC、TIS、SCSK、日立系等），同时有日本大型企业/政企客户直销经验者优先，理解其采购决策流程及组织架构；

3、对云计算产品、解决方案及行业应用有深入理解，具备完整的端到端销售闭环经验（渠道及直销均可），有千万级以上 deal 签约的成功案例；

4、具备强烈的目标导向和猎人思维（Hunter Mindset），自我驱动，能在资源有限的新市场从0到1开拓业务；

5、具备优秀的商务谈判能力、跨团队协调能力及执行力，能够在多方协同环境中主导复杂销售项目落地；

6、具备主流云厂商（如AWS、Azure、GCP、腾讯云等）相关经验或认证者优先，熟练使用数据分析及AI工具者优先；具备AI产品销售经验者优先

7、可接受日本国内及跨国出差

能力要件

1.大卒以上。クラウドコンピューティングまたはICT業界における5年以上のセールス実務経験を有し、チャネル開拓とダイレクトセールス／大手顧客セールスの両方の実戦経験を併せ持つこと。

2.日本クラウドコンピューティング市場およびビジネスエコシステムに精通し、大手システムインテグレーター（SI）との協力経験（NTT DATA、CTC、TIS、SCSK、日立系等）を有すること。また、日本の大手企業／官公庁顧客へのダイレクトセールス経験者を優遇。その調達意思決定プロセスおよび組織構造を理解していること。

3.クラウド製品、ソリューションおよび業界応用について深い理解を有し、完遂されたエンドツーエンドのセールス・クローズド体験（チャネル・ダイレクト双方可）を有すること。数千万円規模以上のディールにおける契約締結の成功実績を有すること。

4.強い目標志向およびハンター・マインドセット（Hunter Mindset）を有し、自走できること。リソースが限られた新規市場において、0→1のビジネス開拓を遂行できること。

5.優れた商談交渉力、クロスチーム協調力および実行力を有し、複数部署が関与する環境下において複雑なセールスプロジェクトの着地をリードできること。

6.主流クラウドベンダー（AWS、Azure、GCP、腾讯云等）の関連経験または認定を有する者を優遇。データ分析およびAIツールの熟練使用者、AI製品セールス経験者を優遇。

7.日本国内および海外出張が可能

一緒に働く魅力/Why Join Us?

平等な雇用機会を重視するテンセント/Equal Employment Opportunity at Tencent

テンセントは、雇用機会の均等を最重要視しています。私たちは、多様性がイノベーションを促進し、ユーザーやコミュニティに対してより良いサービスを提供する原動力になると確信しています。
社員一人ひとりが十分なサポートを受け、自身の目標と会社の目標を共に達成できるよう、モチベーションを高められる環境づくりを大切にしています。

As an equal opportunity employer, we firmly believe that diverse voices fuel our innovation and allow us to better serve our users and the community. We foster an environment where every employee of Tencent feels supported and inspired to achieve individual and common goals.

title: Senior Game Engine Programmer
description:
Business Unit
LIGHTSPEED STUDIOS is made up of passionate players who advance the art & science of game development through great stories, great gameplay, and advanced technology. We are focused on bringing next generation experiences to gamers who want to enjoy them anywhere, anytime, across multiple genres and devices.

About the Hiring Team
Lightspeed Tech Center is a R&D department under Lightspeed Studios which develop PUBG Mobile and other high-quality games. Our Tech Center leads the research, exploration, and discovery of innovative technologies and provides technical services for all games during all phases of life cycle, including engine, audio, QA, AI, next generation game, technical cooperation, etc.

What the Role Entails
We are looking for a Senior Game Engine Programmer to join our engine team and contribute to the development and optimisation of cutting-edge game engine technologies. In this role, you will work on core engine systems across areas such as engine architecture, rendering, animation, physics, performance optimisation and cross-platform development.
You will collaborate closely with gameplay, tools, art and production teams to build scalable and high-performance engine solutions for multiple platforms, including mobile, PC and console. You will also help solve complex engine challenges, and mentor other engineers within the team.
1. Design and implement advanced game engine technologies, including engine architecture, rendering, animation, physics and related systems.

2. Develop and optimise cross-platform engine solutions for mobile, PC and console platforms.

3. Work closely with gameplay, art, design and production teams to deliver robust and efficient technical solutions.

4. Analyse and resolve complex performance, stability and scalability issues across different platforms.

5. Follow and apply the latest technical developments from industry conferences and research papers, such as SIGGRAPH and GDC.

6. Provide technical guidance, code reviews and mentorship to other engineers on the team.

Who We Look For

1. Minimum 5 years of experience in 3D game engine development.

2. Strong understanding of game engine architecture and at least one major technical area such as rendering, animation, physics, performance optimisation.

3. Solid C/C++ programming skills, with strong knowledge of data structures, algorithms and software engineering principles.

4. Experience developing and shipping games or engine technologies on mobile, PC or console platforms.

5. Ability to read, understand and implement techniques from academic papers, industry talks or technical publications.

6. Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently in complex technical areas.

7. Good communication skills and experience collaborating with cross-functional teams.

8. Self-driven, detail-oriented and committed to delivering high-quality technical work.

Preferred Qualifications

1. Experience with commercial engines such as Unreal Engine.

2. Deep expertise in rendering, animation systems, physics simulation or engine performance optimisation.

3. Experience with profiling, debugging and optimisation across multiple platforms.

4. Previous experience mentoring engineers or leading technical initiatives.

title: Tencent Cloud Senior Industry Product Operations Manager — Risk Control & Anti-Fraud (Indonesia)
description:
Business Unit
Cloud & Smart Industries Group (CSIG) is responsible for promoting the company's cloud and industry Internet strategy. CSIG explores the interactions between users and industries to create innovative solutions for smart industries via technological advancements such as cloud, AI, and network security. While driving the digitalization of retail, medical, education, transportation and other industries, CSIG helps companies serve users in smarter ways, building a new ecosystem of intelligent industries that connect users and businesses.

What the Role Entails
We are looking for a (Senior) Industry Product Operations Manager with solid experience in risk control, anti-fraud, business security, and financial risk management, as well as strong commercialisation capabilities and bilingual communication skills in native language and English.
This role will be responsible for supporting the commercialisation and solution delivery of Tencent Cloud Risk Control Solution, TCRS, in overseas markets. The position will serve as a critical bridge between product, sales, solution, delivery, and client teams.

The successful candidate will be expected to deeply understand overseas clients’ risk challenges across scenarios such as registration, login, marketing campaigns, transactions, payments, credit application, account security, and user lifecycle management. The candidate will translate Tencent Cloud’s capabilities in business security, risk identification, anti-fraud, device risk, account security, payment risk control, and financial risk management into industry solutions that are sellable, deliverable, and scalable.
This role requires not only strong technical understanding, but also strong business acumen, client communication skills, and solution packaging capabilities. The candidate will support overseas sales teams throughout the full sales cycle, including requirement discovery, solution design, client presentation, product demonstration, POC execution, pricing support, and commercial conversion.

1. Drive Overseas Commercialisation of TCRS

• Lead the solution design and commercial landing of Tencent Cloud TCRS products in overseas markets, covering risk control, anti-fraud, and financial risk management.

• Develop industry-specific solutions for clients in fintech, digital banking, consumer finance, payments, e-commerce, gaming, content platforms, and social networking.

• Translate TCRS capabilities, including device risk, account security, transaction risk control, payment risk control, credit risk control, rule engines, and model scoring, into clear business value that clients can understand.

2. Support the End-to-End Overseas Sales Process

• Support sales, business development, and channel teams in client requirement discovery, solution design, technical engagement, product demonstration, POC execution, and pricing support.

• Independently conduct product introductions, solution walkthroughs, technical Q&A, and value presentations to clients in both native language and English.

• Help identify clients’ real pain points, purchasing motivations, and decision-making processes, and drive opportunities from the requirement stage to POC, quotation, and contract signing.

3. Design Anti-Fraud and Business Security Solutions

• Analyse client risk issues and design solutions across scenarios such as registration, login, marketing, transactions, payments, and account security.

• Cover typical risk cases including fake registration, account theft, marketing abuse, promotion abuse, card-not-present fraud, chargebacks, account takeover, and organised fraud.

• Design localised risk control solutions by combining capabilities such as device risk, behavioural risk, IP risk, account risk, relationship networks, rules, and machine learning models.

4. Support Financial Risk Management Solutions

• Design pre-loan, in-loan, and post-loan risk management solutions for financial clients, including digital banks, consumer finance companies, cash loan providers, BNPL platforms, payment institutions, and e-wallets.

• Cover key scenarios such as identity verification, application fraud detection, credit assessment, credit approval, limit management, transaction monitoring, post-loan early warning, and collection segmentation.

• Support financial clients in POC test design, performance evaluation, strategy optimisation, and business value assessment.

5. Drive Product Requirement Closure

• Collect overseas client requirements related to anti-fraud, payment risk control, credit risk management, and compliance risk management, and translate them into product requirements and implementation roadmaps.

• Work closely with product, R&D, algorithm, data, delivery, and sales teams to convert client requirements into product capabilities.

• Consolidate project experience from key accounts and develop standardised industry solutions, case studies, POC templates, and sales enablement tools.

6. Sales Enablement and Market Insights

• Deliver product training, industry training, case study training, and competitor training to sales, business development, channel, and partner teams.

• Produce materials such as product introductions, industry solution decks, client case studies, FAQs, competitor analysis, and deployment documentation.

• Track overseas trends in risk control, anti-fraud, fintech, and compliance, and provide input to support the overseas GTM strategy of TCRS.

Who We Look For

• Bachelor’s degree or above;

• Minimum 5 years of experience in internet risk control, anti-fraud, business security, fintech risk management, payment risk control, credit risk management, or related fields.

• Excellent bilingual communication skills in native language and English, with the ability to conduct client communication, solution presentations, business discussions, document drafting, and cross-border team collaboration in English. Madarin Speaking skill is a Plus.

• Strong client-facing communication skills and business understanding, with the ability to independently conduct requirement discovery, solution articulation, and value presentation.

• Strong cross-functional collaboration capabilities, with the ability to coordinate product, R&D, algorithm, delivery, sales, and partner resources to drive complex projects to successful delivery.

Equal Employment Opportunity at Tencent

As an equal opportunity employer, we firmly believe that diverse voices fuel our innovation and allow us to better serve our users and the community. We foster an environment where every employee of Tencent feels supported and inspired to achieve individual and common goals.

title: Global Communications Manager, Games
description:
What the Role Entails
About Tencent

Tencent is a world-leading internet and technology company that develops innovative products and services to improve the quality of life of people around the world. Founded in 1998 with its headquarters in Shenzhen, China, our guiding principle is to use technology for good.

We are not only a major video game publisher in the world, we also produce other high-quality digital content, enriching interactive entertainment experiences for people around the globe. We offer a range of services such as cloud computing, advertising, FinTech, and other enterprise services to support our clients' digital transformation and business growth.

We are rapidly expanding our international operations and are looking for top talent to propel us forward.

Job Overview

Tencent is seeking a seasoned communications specialist to drive the global communications strategy primarily for Tencent Games and game titles in Northeast Asia market, and secondarily support Tencent's corporate communications across Northeast Asiaa market.

This is a strategic, high-impact role for a communications professional who can blend cultural fluency, strategic rigor, and creative instinct to shape how Tencent Games in global market. You will be the in-market communications partner for our portfolio of world-class studios and titles, the steward of regional media relationships, and a key advisor to global and regional leadership on reputation, narrative, and market dynamics.

The role is based in Tokyo or Seoul. You will report on a solid line to the Head of Tencent Games Global Communications, and on a dotted line to the Head of Tencent APAC Corporate Communications, working at the intersection of Tencent Games' global

comms function and Tencent's broader corporate reputation agenda in the region.
● Define and own the communications strategy for Tencent Games and game titles in Northeast Asia market, translating global priorities into locally resonant strategy and narratives that build relevance, trust, and player affinity.

● Drive communications for Tencent Games' portfolio — including published titles and partner studios — across the full product lifecycle in in Northeast Asia market.

● Partner across studios, publishing, marketing, legal, compliance, public affairs, and global comms peers to deliver integrated, well-aligned communications strategy.

● Manage PR agency partners and coordinate with internal stakeholders to drive quality execution, effective resource allocation and measurable communications outcomes.

● With a primary focus on coordinating and executing media communications plans for Tencent's game business in Japan and Korea, including the planning and execution of media events such as press briefings, exhibitions, open days, media tours and executive engagements.

● Support communications needs across Tencent's business groups, namely social communications, digital content, payment, enterprise solutions, in Northeast Asia.

● Build and maintain relationships with the media and relevant external partners to support Tencent's game business and and other business groups, corporate reputation effort in Japan and Korea.

● Lead local content planning and contribution for Tencent's owned channels in Japan and Korea, including social media platforms, websites, newsletters and other corporate communications materials, as well as gather and localize content from internal teams to ensure locally relevant messaging across channels.

● Monitor local media landscape, industry trends and public sentiment, and support issues management and crisis communications in Japan and Korea, working closely with Game Global Comms team/APAC Corporate Communications, business teams, legal and policy teams where needed.

Who We Look For

● 5+ years of experience in PR, corporate communications, or media relations, ideally with meaningful experience at a global company or top-tier international communications agency.

● Solid, hands-on craft across the core PR disciplines — strategy and messaging development, executive and editorial writing, media pitching and event execution, issues and crisis management, spokesperson preparation, and reputation management.

● Demonstrated track record of leading in-market communications and media relations in Japan, with strong existing relationships in the Japanese media landscape.

● Native or near-native Japanese or Korean, written and verbal.

● Fluent Chinese (Mandarin) and/or English — at least one is required at a working professional level.

● Strong cross-functional collaboration skills and the ability to operate effectively in a complex, matrixed, cross-time-zone organization.

● Bachelor's degree or higher in Communications, Public Relations, Journalism, Marketing, or a related field.

Preferred

● a video gamer.

● Prior PR / communications experience in the video games or technology industry.

1. 产品全局把控： 主导休闲消除类游戏产品的整体方向和愿景，制定清晰的产品路线图和升级战略，确保从0到1的创意落地以及从1到N的持续迭代增长，实现产品代际跃升；
2. 跨部门协同： 密切与用户获取（UA）、市场发行、数据分析和商业化团队合作，根据海外市场的买量策略和增长机制及时调整产品方向；结合市场反馈和数据洞察，制定游戏运营活动、付费策略和功能更新计划，推动产品持续增长与长期留存；
3. 质量与进度负责： 把控游戏开发的关键里程碑和最终质量，对产品的品质、进度和预算负责；及时识别和解决项目风险和瓶颈，确保产品按计划上线并达到预期的用户满意度和商业目标；

岗位要求

1. 行业经验： 8年以上游戏开发从业经验，3年以上制作人/主策/产品负责人角色经验，深耕手机休闲游戏领域；
2. 产品类型成功经历： 拥有二合品类休闲游戏的成功项目经验，曾主导或深度参与过知名相关产品的开发或运营；项目月流水超过500万美金。
3. 发行思维： 深刻理解海外移动游戏市场的用户获取渠道和产品增长机制，熟悉买量投放、市场营销和商业化策略；具备数据驱动的思维方式，善于通过A/B测试和用户数据指导产品迭代，提高关键指标（留存、LTV等）；
4. 跨职能协作： 优秀的沟通协调能力，能够在产品、研发与运营等不同部门之间架起桥梁，并与用户获取、发行、营销、商业化等职能团队紧密协作，确保产品开发与市场策略步调一致；
5. 团队领导力： 出色的领导管理才能和人际沟通技巧，善于发掘和培养人才。曾经成功组建并管理过不少于10人的跨职能游戏开发或运营团队；能够在多元文化环境中工作，激励团队实现高绩效；

加分项：
1. 海外合作经验： 有与国际游戏工作室联合开发项目的经验者优先；了解海外合作方的工作方式，能有效管理时区差异和跨文化沟通；
2. 知名企业背景： 曾在国际或国内一流休闲游戏公司担任核心制作岗位者优先，对精品休闲手游的研发流程和品质要求有一线认知；
3. 全球发行经验： 有面向全球市场发行游戏的经验，熟悉海外各主要地区玩家偏好和市场趋势；曾主导产品获得海外市场成功者尤佳；
4. 激情与创新： 对休闲手游充满热情，关注最新的游戏玩法趋势和创新机制，拥有敏锐的市场洞察力和创造性思维，愿意大胆尝试将产品提升到新的高度。
5. 语言能力： 能够熟练地用英语进行沟通和报告，能够在跨国团队中协同工作，并有效地与海外合作伙伴进行交流更佳。

腾讯致力于提供平等就业机会

在腾讯，我们始终秉承平等就业机会的原则，致力于为每一位员工打造公平、包容的工作环境。我们坚信，多元的声音能够激发出无限的创新活力，推动我们为用户和社会提供更优质的服务。我们用心营造一个充满支持与激励的氛围，帮助每一位员工找到属于自己的舞台，以实现个人及共同的发展目标。

description:

LightSpeed Japan Studio is a game development studio dedicated to crafting original AAA action game titles for global audiences. Led by industry veteran Hideaki Itsuno, the studio operates across two locations in Tokyo and Osaka.

The studio offers a flexible and inclusive work environment and actively welcomes game creators who are full of talent and passion for pushing the boundaries of game development.

仕事内容/What the Role Entails

仕事内容

開発中のAAAタイトルの背景アート制作を担当し、ゲームの世界観を深く表現する重要な役割を担っていただきます。具体的な業務内容は以下の通りです。

1.  ゲーム内のエリア、背景、オブジェクトの3Dモデリングおよびテクスチャ作成を行い、リアルな質感とディテールを実現。

2.  コンセプトアートを元に、ゲーム内ビジュアルスタイルに合わせた精緻な背景デザインを制作。

3.  シェーダーやマテリアルの設定を行い、ゲーム内の質感や光沢、反射などを再現。

4.  リアルタイムレンダリングやパフォーマンスの最適化を行い、ゲームプレイのクオリティを維持。

5.  アートディレクターやレベルデザイナーと連携し、ゲームプレイやストーリーと調和した背景の実現。

応募条件

1.  Maya、3ds Max、Blender、ZBrushなどを使用した背景アート制作の実務経験のある方。

2.  Unreal EngineやUnityを使用した背景制作の経験と、パフォーマンス最適化の実務経験のある方。

3.  コンセプトアートを基に、ゲームのビジュアルスタイルに合わせた3D背景のデザイン・制作ができる方。

4.  シェーダーやマテリアルの設定に関する基本的な理解と、リアルな質感を再現できる方。

title: Senior Game Analyst
Senior Game Evaluation Specialist
Data Science Intern
description:
About the Hiring Team
Level Infinite is Tencent’s global gaming brand. It is a global game publisher offering a comprehensive network of services for games, development teams, and studios around the world.

We are dedicated to delivering engaging and original gaming experiences to a worldwide audience, whenever and wherever they choose to play while building a community that fosters inclusivity, connection, and accessibility. Level Infinite also provides a wide range of services and resources to our network of developers and partner studios around the world to help them unlock the true potential of their games.

What the Role Entails
We are looking for an Associate Data Scientist to help build AI-powered capabilities for our influencer marketing platform. This role focuses on turning data and machine learning into practical product features—from creator discovery and content understanding to campaign optimization and performance prediction.
You will work at the intersection of data science, product, and engineering, helping bring intelligent systems into real world use cases that drive measurable business impact.

1. Applied AI & Model Development

•
Develop and deploy machine learning / AI models to enhance platform capabilities.

•
Work on use cases such as:

•
Creator segmentation and recommendation.

•
Creator Content labeling and data analysis.

•
Campaign performance prediction and optimization.

•
Agentic Systems Developing.

2. Problem Framing & Experimentation

•
Translate business and product problems into data science solutions.

•
Design experiments to validate hypotheses and measure impact.

•
Iterate on models based on performance, feedback, and real-world usage.

3. Data Pipeline & Feature Engineering

•
Work with data engineers to define and build scalable data pipelines.

•
Clean, process, and structure large datasets (creator data, content metadata, campaign performance).

•
Design meaningful features that improve model performance.

4. Product Integration

•
Collaborate closely with product managers and engineers to integrate models into the platform.

•
Ensure models are production-ready, reliable, and scalable.

•
Contribute to API design, model serving, and inference workflows.

5. Monitoring & Continuous Improvement

•
Track model performance using appropriate metrics (accuracy, precision, recall, business KPIs).

•
Maintain documentation and ensure reproducibility.

Who We Look For

Core Values

•
Integrity – You prioritize correctness, transparency, and responsible use of data.

•
Gamer Native – You understand gaming ecosystems and player/content dynamics.

•
Pop Culture Fluent – You are familiar with creators, platforms, and digital trends.

•
Tech-Savvy – You are curious and hands-on with emerging AI technologies.

Technical Skills

•
Strong foundation in machine learning and statistics.

•
Proficiency in Python and common ML libraries (e.g., PyTorch,scikit-learn).

•
Experience with data processing (e.g., pandas, SQL).

•
Familiarity with LLMs, NLP, or recommendation systems is a strong plus.

•
Understanding of model deployment (APIs, batch/real-time inference) is preferred.

Data & Product Thinking

•
Ability to translate ambiguous business problems into data science solutions.

•
Strong analytical thinking and hypothesis-driven approach.

•
Understanding of how models create value in a product context (not just offline metrics).

Execution & Collaboration

•
Ability to work cross-functionally with product, engineering, and business teams.

•
Good communication skills—able to explain complex models in simple terms.

•
Strong ownership and ability to iterate quickly.

Nice to Have

•
Experience in influencer marketing, advertising, or creator platforms.

•
Familiarity with social media data (e.g., YouTube, Twitch, TikTok ecosystems).

•
Experience with embeddings, vector databases, or retrieval systems.

•
Basic knowledge of data engineering or MLOps workflows.

Example Projects You Might Work On

•
